definition_zh: 天然的；粗糙的；粗鲁的；粗略的
definition_en: in a raw natural state, made without skill, or said without tact
core_image: 从井口直接舀起的一勺原油，还混着泥沙
scene: 工地上有人从桶里舀出一勺还混着泥沙的原油。They loaded the crude oil straight onto the truck.
sceneCN: 这里 crude 指「天然的、未加工的」（第 1 个义项：从地下取出后还没提炼的）；句意是他们把原油直接装上卡车。

pos.zh: 天然的；粗糙的；粗鲁的；粗略的

senses.title: Raw, unrefined
senses.definition: in a natural state and not yet processed
senses.definitionCN: 处于自然状态、尚未加工的
senses.example: The refinery turns crude oil into fuel.
senses.exampleCN: 炼油厂把原油变成燃料。
senses.why: What comes out of the ground must be cleaned before use.
senses.whyCN: 从地下出来的东西，用前总要先洗净。

senses.title: Roughly made
senses.definition: made quickly and without skill or care
senses.definitionCN: 做得快而缺乏技艺或用心
senses.example: He built a crude shelter from branches.
senses.exampleCN: 他用树枝搭了个粗糙的棚子。
senses.why: Untrained hands leave their marks on what they make.
senses.whyCN: 没练过的手，会在做的东西上留下痕迹。

senses.title: Rude, without tact
senses.definition: said or done in a way that shocks or offends people
senses.definitionCN: 以令人震惊或冒犯的方式说出或做出
senses.example: His crude remark silenced the room.
senses.exampleCN: 他那句粗鲁的话让全场安静下来。
senses.why: A missing polish in words cuts like a rough edge.
senses.whyCN: 话里少了打磨，就像毛边一样割人。

intro.en: Crude comes from Latin crudus, raw or unripe, through Old French crud.
intro.cn: crude 源自拉丁语 crudus（生的、未熟的），经古法语 crud 进入英语。

items.en: Crudus described food that was raw or not cooked.
items.cn: crudus 形容生的、没煮过的食物。

items.en: It also meant unripe, or hard to digest.
items.cn: 它也表示未成熟、难以消化。

items.en: Crud kept both the raw and the unripe senses.
items.cn: crud 同时保留了生与未熟两层意思。

items.en: Crude first described raw food and unripe fruit.
items.cn: crude 最初形容生食与未熟的水果。

items.en: It spread to rough work and rude words.
items.cn: 它扩展到粗糙的手艺与粗鲁的言语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cru- opening, and the meaning group names things still in a raw state.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cru- 开头，近义组列出仍处于原始状态的说法。

entries.definition: the hard outer layer of bread
a very small piece of bread

entries.definitionCN: 不平滑或未精细完成的

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with something pulled from the ground and end with words that cut.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一件刚出土的东西开始，落到几句会割人的话上。

normal.en: Crude is the state before the factory touches it.
normal.cn: crude 是工厂还没碰过它时的状态。

normal.en: A crude chair still holds you up, but it wobbles.
normal.cn: 粗糙的椅子仍能撑住你，只是会晃。

normal.en: Crude words are words with the polish sanded off.
normal.cn: 粗鲁的话，是被磨掉了光的那层话。

normal.en: Raw oil, raw wood, raw manners: one word for all.
normal.cn: 原油、原木、没教养的举止：一个词全包。

normal.en: If it came straight out and skipped the finishing, it is crude.
normal.cn: 直接从里面出来、跳过了修饰的，就是 crude。

abstract.en: Picture oil black and thick, still smoking from the well.
abstract.cn: 想象又黑又稠的油，从井口还冒着气。

abstract.en: Picture a table made of one unplaned board.
abstract.cn: 想象一张只用一块没刨过的板做成的桌子。

abstract.en: Picture a laugh that lands on the wrong face.
abstract.cn: 想象一声笑落在不该落的那张脸上。

examples.en: The crude oil is refined before it is sold.
examples.cn: 原油在出售前要先提炼。

examples.en: He made a crude table from three old boards.
examples.cn: 他用三块旧木板做了一张粗糙的桌子。

examples.en: Her crude comment hurt everyone at the table.
examples.cn: 她那句粗鲁的评论伤了在座所有人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crude 记成「生的」：原油、生手、生硬的话，都还没经过打磨。

root: 源自拉丁语 crudus（生的、未熟的），经古法语 crud 进入英语；本义是未经烹煮与提炼，后来引申为做得粗糙、说话粗鲁。

sensesIntro.en: From raw material, to rough work, to words that wound.
sensesIntro.cn: 从没加工的原料，到粗糙的手艺，再到伤人的话。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bucket of oil lifted straight from the well.
core.cn: 核心意象：一桶刚从井里提上来的原油。

branches.en: What the earth gives is used before it is cleaned.
branches.cn: 大地给出的东西，还没洗净就被用上。

branches.en: A thing made in a hurry keeps its rough edges.
branches.cn: 匆忙做出来的东西，会留着粗糙的边。

branches.en: A remark without polish can cut the listener.
branches.cn: 没打磨过的话，会割到听的人。

branches.en: Raw material and rough work share one word.
branches.cn: 原料与粗活共用一个词。

branches.en: Rough edges appear in things and in manners.
branches.cn: 粗糙的边既出现在物件上，也出现在举止里。

intro.en: Crude belongs to the Latin crudus family, where raw matter and rough manners meet.
intro.cn: crude 属于拉丁语 crudus 这一族，原料与粗鲁在这里相遇。

latinIntro.en: The Latin crudus, raw or unripe, is the root under all these words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crudus（生的、未熟的）是这些词共同的根。

items.example: Crude oil burns with dark smoke.
The crudity of the plan shocked us.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划的粗糙让我们吃惊。

items.example: The crudeness of the joke upset her.
items.exampleCN: 那玩笑的粗俗让她不快。

items.example: Wash that crud off your hands.

items.meaning: raw vegetables served as a dish
items.exampleCN: 晚饭前他们上了生蔬菜拼盘。

items.meaning: the return of a disease or problem
items.example: Doctors feared a recrudescence of the fever.

items.meaning: oil as it comes from the ground

definition_zh: 残忍的；残酷的；令人痛苦的
definition_en: willing to make others suffer, or hard and painful to bear
core_image: 一只脚悬在一只小虫上方，迟迟不落下
scene: 孩子把蚂蚁扣在玻璃杯下，笑着看它乱撞。It was cruel to trap the ant and watch it struggle.
sceneCN: 这里 cruel 指「残忍的」（第 1 个义项：以别人的痛苦为乐）；句意是把蚂蚁扣住、看它挣扎，是很残忍的。

pos.zh: 残忍的；残酷的；令人痛苦的

senses.title: Pleased by pain
senses.definition: willing to cause pain and taking pleasure in it
senses.definitionCN: 愿意让别人痛苦，并以此取乐
senses.example: It is cruel to laugh at a child who falls.
senses.exampleCN: 嘲笑摔倒的孩子是残忍的。
senses.why: Pain should end a joke, never be its point.
senses.whyCN: 痛苦该让玩笑停下，而不该成为玩笑的目的。

senses.title: Causing suffering
senses.definition: causing pain, whether on purpose or not
senses.definitionCN: 无论有意与否都造成痛苦
senses.example: The long drought was cruel to the farmers.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的旱情对农民很残酷。
senses.why: The world can wound without any hand behind it.
senses.whyCN: 世界本身就会伤人，不需要谁在背后动手。

senses.title: Hard to bear
senses.definition: so hard or severe that it is painful to accept
senses.definitionCN: 艰难或严酷到令人难以接受
senses.example: Losing in the last minute was a cruel blow.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一刻输掉是沉重的一击。
senses.why: A fact can strike as hard as a fist.
senses.whyCN: 一个事实能像拳头一样砸下来。

intro.en: Cruel comes from Latin crudelis, hard-hearted, from crudus, raw.
intro.cn: cruel 源自拉丁语 crudelis（心硬的），其根是 crudus（生的）。

items.en: Crudelis described a hard heart that felt no pity.
items.cn: crudelis 形容一颗不觉怜悯的硬心。

items.en: It grew from crudus, raw, meaning not softened.
items.cn: 它出自 crudus（生的），意即没有软化。

items.en: Cruel named a person who took joy in pain.
items.cn: cruel 指以他人痛苦为乐的人。

items.en: Cruel entered English for harsh masters and hard acts.
items.cn: cruel 进入英语，用于严厉的主人与冷酷的行为。

items.en: It also describes fate, weather, and blows.
items.cn: 它也能形容命运、天气与打击。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cru- stem, and the meaning group names other kinds of hardness.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cru- 词干，近义组列出其他表示狠硬的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a foot held in the air and end with words that land like stones.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只停在半空的脚开始，落到像石头一样砸下的话。

normal.en: Cruel hearts do not feel the weight they press.
normal.cn: 狠心的人感觉不到自己压下去的分量。

normal.en: A joke that needs a victim is not a joke.
normal.cn: 需要一个受害者的玩笑，就不是玩笑。

normal.en: Fate can be cruel without having any hands.
normal.cn: 命运没有手，也能很残忍。

normal.en: The last minute is often the cruellest minute.
normal.cn: 最后一分钟常常是最残酷的一分钟。

normal.en: Cruel is what pity forgot to soften.
normal.cn: cruel 就是怜悯忘了去软化的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a hand that stops just above a small insect.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手停在一只小虫上方。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd laughing and one person walking away.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人笑着，一个人转身走开。

abstract.en: Picture frost killing flowers that had just opened.
abstract.cn: 想象霜打死刚开的花。

examples.en: It is cruel to keep a large dog in a small cage.
examples.cn: 把大狗关在小笼子里是残忍的。

examples.en: The old king was cruel to those who disobeyed.
examples.cn: 老国王对不服从他的人很残酷。

examples.en: Losing the farm was a cruel lesson for the family.
examples.cn: 失去农场对这家人是残酷的一课。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cruel 记成「心硬」：cru 是生的，el 像一道划痕，心没被软化，就会划伤别人。

root: 源自拉丁语 crudelis（心硬的、无情的），与 crudus（生的）同源，经古法语 cruel 进入英语；本义是心未软化，对他人的痛痒无感。

sensesIntro.en: From taking pleasure in pain, to causing it, to bearing what cannot be softened.
sensesIntro.cn: 从以别人的痛为乐，到造成痛苦，再到承受无法软化的事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a foot held above a small insect.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只脚悬在一只小虫上方。

branches.en: A hard heart can watch pain and smile.
branches.cn: 硬起来的心能看着痛苦还笑。

branches.en: Harm may come from a will or from the world.
branches.cn: 伤害可能来自意志，也可能来自世界。

branches.en: Some blows are too heavy to soften.
branches.cn: 有些打击重得无法软化。

branches.en: The one who enjoys pain and the drought share a name.
branches.cn: 以痛苦为乐的人与旱情共用一个词。

branches.en: What hurts us is called cruel, whatever its source.
branches.cn: 凡是伤到我们的，不管来自哪里，都叫残忍。

intro.en: Cruel and crude share the Latin crudus, raw, which grew into two kinds of hardness.
intro.cn: cruel 与 crude 共享拉丁语 crudus（生的），后来长成两种不同的硬。

latinIntro.en: The Latin crudelis, hard-hearted, is the root behind this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crudelis（心硬的）是这一族词背后的根。

items.example: A cruel word can last for years.
items.exampleCN: 一句残忍的话能留很多年。

items.meaning: the act or habit of being cruel
items.example: The cruelty of the guard was well known.
items.exampleCN: 那个看守的残忍人人皆知。

items.example: He was cruelly treated as a child.
items.exampleCN: 他小时候受到残忍对待。

items.example: A cruel-hearted ruler feared no one.
items.exampleCN: 铁石心肠的统治者谁也不怕。

items.example: The cruelness of the winter surprised them.
items.exampleCN: 那个冬天的严酷让他们意外。

items.example: Crude wood must be dried first.
The crudity of his answer shocked her.
items.exampleCN: 他回答的粗鲁让她震惊。

definition_zh: 乘船游览；巡航；以稳定速度行驶
definition_en: to travel by ship for pleasure, or to move at a steady, easy speed
core_image: 白色游轮贴着蓝色海面缓缓滑过
scene: 白色游轮贴着海面缓缓滑过，甲板上的人晒着太阳。They cruise along the coast for a week each summer.
sceneCN: 这里 cruise 指「乘船游览」（第 1 个义项：为休闲而坐船航行）；句意是每年夏天他们沿着海岸巡游一周。

pos.zh: 乘船游览；巡航；以稳定速度行驶

senses.title: A pleasure voyage
senses.definition: a holiday trip by ship, or to make such a trip
senses.definitionCN: 坐船度假的旅行，或进行这样的旅行
senses.example: We took a cruise around the islands.
senses.exampleCN: 我们绕着群岛坐船玩了一圈。
senses.why: A ship turns travel itself into the destination.
senses.whyCN: 船让旅途本身变成目的地。

senses.title: Steady patrolling
senses.definition: to sail or fly on a fixed route for patrol or duty
senses.definitionCN: 沿固定路线航行或飞行以巡逻、执勤
senses.example: Two ships cruise the bay every night.
senses.exampleCN: 两艘船每晚在海湾巡航。
senses.why: A route walked again and again becomes a duty.
senses.whyCN: 同一条路线一遍遍走，就成了职责。

senses.title: A steady speed
senses.definition: to move or drive at a steady, easy speed
senses.definitionCN: 以平稳省力的速度移动或驾驶
senses.example: The car cruises at ninety on the open road.
senses.exampleCN: 这车在开阔路上以九十匀速行驶。
senses.why: At one easy speed, the machine stops fighting the road.
senses.whyCN: 保持一个省力的速度，机器就不再和路较劲。

intro.en: Cruise comes from Dutch kruisen, to cross, from Latin crux, a cross; a ship that crosses back and forth is cruising.
intro.cn: cruise 源自荷兰语 kruisen（横过、交叉），更早出自拉丁语 crux（十字）；船来回横过海面，就是巡航。

items.en: Kruisen meant to cross or move to and fro.
items.cn: kruisen 意为横过或来回移动。

items.en: It came from crux, a cross, the shape of crossing lines.
items.cn: 它出自 crux（十字），即交叉线的形状。

items.en: To cruise was to sail to and fro in search of ships.
items.cn: cruise 指在海上来回航行以搜寻船只。

items.en: Steam ships made cruising a pleasure trip.
items.cn: 汽船让巡航变成了休闲旅行。

items.en: Cars and planes now cruise at a steady speed.
items.cn: 如今汽车与飞机也以稳定速度巡航。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cru- opening and the -ise ending, and the meaning group names other journeys on water.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cru- 开头与 -ise 结尾，近义组列出其他水上旅程的说法。

entries.definition: a fast warship or a motor boat
a dark mark on the skin
a small bottle for oil or vinegar
to travel on water by wind
to move around an area to guard it

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a white ship on flat water and end with a car holding one easy speed.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一艘在平静海面上的白船开始，落到一辆保持匀速的车。

normal.en: A cruise is a journey that has become the destination.
normal.cn: 乘船巡游，是旅途本身变成了目的地。

normal.en: The ship crosses the sea and calls it a holiday.
normal.cn: 船横过海面，把这叫作假期。

normal.en: Cruise control lets the car keep one steady speed.
normal.cn: 定速巡航让车保持一个稳定的速度。

normal.en: To cruise is to cross without hurry.
normal.cn: cruise 就是不慌不忙地横过去。

normal.en: A cruiser is either a warship or a fast boat.
normal.cn: cruiser 不是军舰就是快艇。

abstract.en: Picture a white ship cutting a long line in blue water.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘白船在蓝色海面上划出长线。

abstract.en: Picture a deck chair and a book left open.
abstract.cn: 想象一张甲板椅和一本摊开的书。

abstract.en: Picture a needle holding one speed on the dial.
abstract.cn: 想象指针在表盘上定住一个速度。

examples.en: They cruise the islands every winter.
examples.cn: 他们每年冬天乘船游群岛。

examples.en: The ship cruised slowly past the harbour.
examples.cn: 船缓缓驶过港口。

examples.en: He put the car in cruise and relaxed.
examples.cn: 他打开定速巡航，放松下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cruise 记成「横过去」：cru 是十字（crux），船横过海面，就成了巡游。

root: 源自荷兰语 kruisen（横过、交叉），更早出自拉丁语 crux（十字）；本义是在海面上来回横越，后指巡航，再引申为乘车船从容行进。

sensesIntro.en: From crossing the sea to patrolling it, then to any steady motion.
sensesIntro.cn: 从横越海面，到在海面巡逻，再到任何平稳的行进。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white ship drawing a slow line across blue water.
core.cn: 核心意象：一艘白船在蓝色海面上划出缓慢的线。

branches.en: A crossing made for pleasure becomes a holiday.
branches.cn: 为享乐而做的横越，成了假期。

branches.en: A route sailed again and again becomes a patrol.
branches.cn: 一遍遍走的航线，成了巡逻。

branches.en: One easy speed is a cruise on any road.
branches.cn: 一个省力的速度，在任何路上都叫巡航。

branches.en: Pleasure trips and patrols both keep crossing the water.
branches.cn: 游船与巡逻都在不断横过水面。

branches.en: Steady motion is the thread under all three senses.
branches.cn: 平稳的行进是这三个义项共同的线。

intro.en: Cruise and cruiser belong to the Latin crux, a cross, the shape of a route that crosses water.
intro.cn: cruise 与 cruiser 属于拉丁语 crux（十字）一族，那是航线横过水面的形状。

latinIntro.en: The Latin crux, a cross, is the root under cruise and cross alike.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crux（十字）是 cruise 与 cross 共同的根。

items.meaning: to cross water back and forth
items.example: They cruise the coast in summer.

items.meaning: a fast warship or motor boat
items.example: A cruiser met them at the bay.
items.exampleCN: 一艘巡洋舰在海湾迎接他们。

items.meaning: the act of sailing to and fro
a large ship for holiday trips
items.example: The cruise ship holds three thousand people.

items.meaning: a device that holds a steady speed
to go from one side to the other
items.example: They cross the river by ferry.

items.meaning: a long fight for a cause
items.meaningCN: 为某种主张的长久斗争
items.example: She led a crusade for clean water.
items.exampleCN: 她发起了一场争取干净水的运动。

items.example: The story says they crucified him.
items.exampleCN: 故事说他们把他钉上了十字架。

definition_zh: 压碎；压坏；击溃；拥挤的人群
definition_en: to press something so hard that it breaks, or to defeat, or a crowd pressed tight
core_image: 一只脚踩在空罐上，罐身瞬间塌下去
scene: 他抬脚把空罐踩扁，铁皮发出脆响。The machine will crush the stones into fine sand.
sceneCN: 这里 crush 指「压碎」（第 1 个义项：用大力把东西压破压扁）；句意是机器会把石头压成细沙。

senses.title: Press until it breaks
senses.definition: to press something hard until it breaks or loses shape
senses.definitionCN: 用力压某物直到破裂或变形
senses.example: She crushed the garlic with the flat of a knife.
senses.exampleCN: 她用刀面把蒜压碎。
senses.why: Weight plus a hard surface ends a shape.
senses.whyCN: 重量加上硬面，就终结了一个形状。

senses.title: Defeat completely
senses.definition: to beat an opponent completely
senses.definitionCN: 彻底打败对手
senses.example: The home team crushed the visitors by five goals.
senses.exampleCN: 主队以五球大胜客队。
senses.why: What is pressed flat cannot stand up again.
senses.whyCN: 被压平的东西，站不起来了。

senses.title: A tight crowd
senses.definition: a crowd pressed so tightly that movement is hard
senses.definitionCN: 挤得难以移动的人群
senses.example: We were caught in a crush at the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 我们被堵在门口的拥挤人群里。
senses.why: Bodies packed like seeds in one pod.
senses.whyCN: 身体挤在一起，像豆荚里的豆子。

intro.en: Crush comes from Old French cruissir, to crack or gnash, perhaps from a Frankish word for pressing.
intro.cn: crush 源自古法语 cruissir（使裂开、咬牙），可能出自表示挤压的法兰克语词。

items.en: Cruissir meant to crack or to gnash the teeth.
items.cn: cruissir 意为使裂开或咬牙。

items.en: Crush first meant to break something by pressing.
items.cn: crush 最初指用挤压把东西弄破。

items.en: It was used for armies that broke an enemy.
items.cn: 它被用于形容军队击溃敌人。

items.en: A crowd pressed tight was called a crush.
items.cn: 挤得紧紧的人群被称为 crush。

items.en: It also names a strong but passing liking.
items.cn: 它也表示一种强烈却短暂的喜欢。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cr- opening and a hissing end, and the meaning group names other kinds of pressing and breaking.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cr- 开头与嘶声结尾，近义组列出其他挤压与破坏的说法。

entries.definition: the hard outer layer of bread
to break into pieces with force
to beat someone in a contest

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a can under a foot and end with a team that cannot stand up.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只被踩在脚下的罐子开始，落到一支站不起来的队伍。

normal.en: A foot and a can explain the whole word.
normal.cn: 一只脚和一只罐子，就解释了整个词。

normal.en: Press until the shape gives up.
normal.cn: 一直压，直到形状认输。

normal.en: A crushed team leaves the field flat.
normal.cn: 被击溃的队伍像被压平一样离场。

normal.en: In a crush, elbows do the talking.
normal.cn: 在拥挤的人群里，胳膊肘在说话。

normal.en: A crush is a feeling pressed into a small space.
normal.cn: 迷恋是被压进小小空间里的一份感情。

abstract.en: Picture a can folding under a boot.
abstract.cn: 想象一只罐子在靴子下折下去。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd so tight that no one can turn.
abstract.cn: 想象人群紧得谁也没法转身。

abstract.en: Picture a paper cup flattened on a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一只纸杯被压扁在桌上。

examples.en: Do not crush the box; it holds glass.
examples.cn: 别把箱子压坏，里面有玻璃。

examples.en: The team crushed its rival in the final.
examples.cn: 这支队伍在决赛中击溃了对手。

examples.en: She was caught in the crush at the door.
examples.cn: 她被堵在门口的拥挤人群里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crush 记成「压到出声」：cr 像裂开的声响，ush 像一口气被挤出来。

root: 源自古法语 cruissir（使裂开、咬牙），可能出自表示挤压的法兰克语词；本义是压到破裂，后引申为击溃与挤紧的人群。

sensesIntro.en: From pressing a thing until it breaks, to breaking an enemy, to a crowd pressed tight.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把东西压破，到击溃对手，再到挤紧的人群。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a boot coming down on an empty can.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只靴子踩在一只空罐上。

branches.en: Pressing hard enough ends the shape of a thing.
branches.cn: 压得够狠，东西的形状就没了。

branches.en: A beaten team is a shape pressed flat.
branches.cn: 被打败的队伍，就是被压平的形状。

branches.en: A crowd can press bodies as a hand presses a can.
branches.cn: 人群挤身体，就像手挤罐子。

branches.en: The same force breaks metal and breaks a rival.
branches.cn: 同一种力既弄坏金属，也弄垮对手。

branches.en: Defeat and crowding both leave no room to move.
branches.cn: 失败与拥挤都让人没有转身的空间。

intro.en: Crush gathers words for pressing, breaking, and the machines that do it.
intro.cn: crush 这一族词围绕压、破，以及做这些事的机器。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root here; the word comes from Old French cruissir, to crack.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根；这个词来自古法语 cruissir（使裂开）。

items.example: The news was a crushing blow.
items.exampleCN: 这消息是毁灭性的打击。

items.example: The box is crushable and light.

items.exampleCN: 他直白得让人招架不住。

items.meaning: a fence that holds back a crowd
items.example: Police stood at the crush barrier.
The worker had a crush injury.

definition_en: the hard outer layer of bread, or any hard covering on a surface
core_image: 一只刚出炉的面包，表皮被敲出脆响
scene: 面包刚出炉，手指一弹表皮就发出脆响。A thick crust keeps the loaf soft inside.
sceneCN: 这里 crust 指「面包皮」（第 1 个义项：面包外面烤硬的一层）；句意是厚厚的外皮让面包里面保持柔软。

senses.title: The outer bread layer
senses.definition: the hard baked outer layer of bread
senses.definitionCN: 面包烤硬的外层
senses.example: She cut the crust off her sandwich.
senses.exampleCN: 她把三明治的边切掉了。
senses.why: Heat dries the outside first, sealing the soft inside.
senses.whyCN: 热先烤干外面，把柔软封在里面。

senses.title: A hard outer shell
senses.definition: a hard layer that forms on the outside of something
senses.definitionCN: 在某物外面形成的一层硬壳
senses.example: A crust of ice covered the pond.
senses.exampleCN: 一层冰盖住了池塘。
senses.why: Cold air hardens the surface it touches.
senses.whyCN: 冷空气把它碰到的表面变硬。

senses.title: The outer shell of the earth
senses.definition: the solid outer layer of the earth
senses.definitionCN: 地球坚硬的外层
senses.example: Earthquakes start deep in the crust.
senses.exampleCN: 地震始于地壳深处。
senses.why: Even a planet wears a baked skin.
senses.whyCN: 连一颗行星也披着一层烤硬的外皮。

intro.en: Crust comes from Latin crusta, a rind or hard shell, through Old French crouste.
intro.cn: crust 源自拉丁语 crusta（外壳、硬皮），经古法语 crouste 进入英语。

items.en: Crusta meant a rind or a hard outer shell.
items.cn: crusta 指外皮或坚硬的壳。

items.en: It covered bread, cheese, and the face of stone.
items.cn: 它可用于面包、奶酪与石头表面。

items.en: Crouste named the baked outside of bread.
items.cn: crouste 指面包烤硬的外层。

items.en: Crust meant the hard outside of a loaf.
items.cn: crust 指面包硬的外层。

items.en: It extended to the hard outer layer of the earth.
items.cn: 它扩展到地球坚硬的表层。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cr- opening and a hard final sound, and the meaning group names other outer coverings.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cr- 开头与硬收尾，近义组列出其他外层的说法。

entries.definition: a very small piece of bread
the red coat on old iron
the thick outer skin of fruit
a layer spread over a surface

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a warm loaf and end with the skin of a planet.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只热面包开始，落到一颗行星的外皮。

normal.en: Break the crust and steam comes out.
normal.cn: 掰开外皮，热气就冒出来。

normal.en: The crust is the part that took the heat.
normal.cn: 外皮是承受了热的那一层。

normal.en: Bread, ice, and the earth all wear one.
normal.cn: 面包、冰和大地都披着一层。

normal.en: A crusty loaf is loud when you press it.
normal.cn: 硬皮面包一按就响。

normal.en: Under the crust, everything stays soft.
normal.cn: 外皮之下，一切都还柔软。

abstract.en: Picture a knife tapping a loaf and hearing a knock.
abstract.cn: 想象刀背敲在面包上，听见一声脆响。

abstract.en: Picture thin ice holding a stone on a pond.
abstract.cn: 想象薄冰托着池塘上的一块石头。

abstract.en: Picture a thin line between soil and deep rock.
abstract.cn: 想象泥土与深岩之间的一条细线。

examples.en: The pie has a golden crust.
examples.cn: 这个馅饼有一层金黄的皮。

examples.en: Salt crusted the roads after the flood.
examples.cn: 洪水过后路面结了一层盐壳。

examples.en: The crust of the earth is thin under the ocean.
examples.cn: 海洋下方的地壳很薄。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crust 记成「烤硬的一层」：面包、冰面、地壳，都是外面先硬的那层。

root: 源自拉丁语 crusta（外壳、硬皮），经古法语 crouste 进入英语；本义是面包外层烤硬的部分，后扩展为任何硬层与地壳。

sensesIntro.en: From the baked outside of bread, to any hard layer, to the shell of the earth.
sensesIntro.cn: 从面包烤硬的外层，到任何硬层，再到地球的外壳。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a warm loaf with a crisp brown shell.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只带着焦脆棕色外壳的热面包。

branches.en: The oven hardens the outside of the bread.
branches.cn: 炉火把面包的外层烤硬。

branches.en: Cold or salt can build a hard layer too.
branches.cn: 寒冷或盐也能结出一层硬壳。

branches.en: The whole planet rests inside one thin shell.
branches.cn: 整颗行星都包在一层薄壳里。

branches.en: Bread and ice both dry into a shell.
branches.cn: 面包与冰都干成一层壳。

branches.en: The same word covers a pond and a planet.
branches.cn: 同一个词既盖住池塘，也盖住行星。

intro.en: Crust brings a small family of words for hard outer layers and the things that wear them.
intro.cn: crust 带来一小族词，都与坚硬的外层以及披着外层的物有关。

latinIntro.en: The Latin crusta, a rind, is the root behind crust and crustacean.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 crusta（外皮）是 crust 与 crustacean 背后的根。

items.example: The bread has a dark crust.
items.exampleCN: 这面包有一层深色外皮。

items.example: The boots were crusted with mud.
She asked for a crustless sandwich.
items.exampleCN: 她要了一份去边的三明治。

items.meaning: to cover with a hard layer
to form a hard top layer
items.example: The snow crusted over at night.
items.exampleCN: 夜里雪面结了一层硬壳。

definition_en: to shed tears, or to call out loudly
core_image: 一个孩子站在门口，眼泪往下掉，同时大声喊人
scene: 孩子摔在门口，眼泪掉下来，放声喊人。She began to cry when the door closed behind her.
sceneCN: 这里 cry 指「哭」（第 1 个义项：因悲伤或疼痛而流泪）；句意是门在她身后关上时，她哭了起来。

senses.title: Shed tears
senses.definition: to let tears fall because of pain or sadness
senses.definitionCN: 因疼痛或悲伤而流泪
senses.example: The baby cried all night.
senses.exampleCN: 婴儿哭了一整夜。
senses.why: Tears are the body speaking when words fail.
senses.whyCN: 说不出话时，眼泪替身体开口。

senses.title: Call out loudly
senses.definition: to shout loudly so as to be heard
senses.definitionCN: 大声喊叫以让人听见
senses.example: He cried out when the door slammed.
senses.exampleCN: 门砰地关上时他叫了一声。
senses.why: A voice thrown far, hoping someone catches it.
senses.whyCN: 声音被扔得很远，希望有人接住。

senses.title: The call of an animal
senses.definition: the loud call of a bird or animal
senses.definitionCN: 鸟或动物响亮的叫声
senses.example: We heard the cry of a fox at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 黄昏时我们听见狐狸的叫声。
senses.why: Every kind of creature has a voice of its own.
senses.whyCN: 每一种生灵都有自己的嗓子。

intro.en: Cry comes from Old French crier, from Latin quiritare, to wail and call for help.
intro.cn: cry 源自古法语 crier，更早出自拉丁语 quiritare（哀号、呼救）。

items.en: Quiritare meant to wail and call for help.
items.cn: quiritare 意为哀号并呼救。

items.en: Crier meant to shout or to weep.
items.cn: crier 意为大声喊或哭泣。

items.en: Cry first meant to call out to someone.
items.cn: cry 最初指朝某人呼喊。

items.en: It also came to mean shedding tears.
items.cn: 它也开始表示流泪。

items.en: It names the call of birds and animals too.
items.cn: 它也能指鸟兽的叫声。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -ry ending or the cr- opening, and the meaning group names other sounds of grief.
note.cn: 形近组共享 -ry 结尾或 cr- 开头，近义组列出其他表达悲伤的声音。

entries.definition: a long high cry of pain

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a child at a door and end with a fox on a dark hill.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从门口一个孩子开始，落到黑山坡上的一只狐狸。

normal.en: Tears first, then a voice, then a word.
normal.cn: 先有眼泪，再有声音，最后才有话。

normal.en: To cry is to let the body speak.
normal.cn: cry 就是让身体开口。

normal.en: A cry for help is meant to travel far.
normal.cn: 呼救的那一声，本来就要传得很远。

normal.en: Foxes cry at dusk without any sorrow.
normal.cn: 狐狸在黄昏叫，并不带悲伤。

normal.en: A cry can be tears or a shout, one word holds both.
normal.cn: 哭声与喊声共用一个词。

abstract.en: Picture a face turned up, eyes full.
abstract.cn: 想象一张仰起的脸，眼里满是水。

abstract.en: Picture a shout crossing an empty street.
abstract.cn: 想象一声喊穿过空街。

abstract.en: Picture a fox standing still on a hill.
abstract.cn: 想象一只狐狸停在山坡上。

examples.en: The child cried when the light went out.
examples.cn: 灯灭时孩子哭了。

examples.en: She heard a cry in the dark street.
examples.cn: 她在黑街上听见一声喊叫。

examples.en: Birds cry at dawn outside the window.
examples.cn: 鸟儿在窗外天亮时叫。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cry 记成「开口」：眼里开口是哭，嗓子里开口是喊。

root: 源自古法语 crier，更早出自拉丁语 quiritare（哀号、呼救）；本义是大声呼救，后同时指流泪与鸟兽的叫声。

sensesIntro.en: From tears, to a loud call, to the voice of an animal.
sensesIntro.cn: 从眼泪，到高声呼喊，再到动物的叫声。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a child at the door with tears and a shout.
core.cn: 核心意象：门口一个流着泪又喊着人的孩子。

branches.en: Tears answer a feeling that has no words.
branches.cn: 眼泪回应一种说不出口的感受。

branches.en: A shout is thrown out so that someone hears.
branches.cn: 喊声被扔出去，是为了让人听见。

branches.en: Birds and beasts cry without any sadness.
branches.cn: 鸟兽的叫声并不带悲伤。

branches.en: Both tears and shouts come from the same open mouth.
branches.cn: 眼泪与喊声都出自同一张张开的嘴。

branches.en: A human call and an animal call share a name.
branches.cn: 人的喊声与动物的叫声共用一个词。

intro.en: Cry forms words for calling out, for weeping, and for those who cannot stop.
intro.cn: cry 组成一族词，关于呼喊、哭泣，以及停不下来的人。

latinIntro.en: The Latin quiritare, to call for help, is the old root under cry.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quiritare（呼救）是 cry 古老的根。

items.example: There is no crying over lost time.
items.exampleCN: 为失去的时间哭泣没有用。

items.example: The town crier rang his bell.
items.exampleCN: 镇上的报信人摇响了铃。
这个计划引来强烈抗议。
批评者谴责这条新规定。

items.meaning: a shout used to urge fighters
items.example: The soldiers raised a battle cry.

definition_en: a clear mineral, or a solid whose parts form a regular repeating shape
core_image: 一块透明的水晶，棱面把光折成几道
scene: 窗台上有一块透明的水晶，阳光穿过去散成几道光。The crystal caught the light and threw small rainbows on the wall.
sceneCN: 这里 crystal 指「水晶」（第 1 个义项：透明且带规则棱面的矿物）；句意是水晶接住光，在墙上投出小小的彩虹。

senses.title: Clear mineral
senses.definition: a clear hard mineral used in jewellery and glass
senses.definitionCN: 用于首饰与玻璃的透明坚硬矿物
senses.example: The ring holds a small crystal.
senses.exampleCN: 戒指上镶着一小块水晶。
senses.why: Light passes through it without being swallowed.
senses.whyCN: 光穿过它，没有被吞掉。

senses.title: A regular solid form
senses.definition: a solid whose particles form a regular repeating shape
senses.definitionCN: 微粒排成规则重复形状的固体
senses.example: Salt forms small crystals as it dries.
senses.exampleCN: 盐在变干时结成小晶体。
senses.why: Order appears when a liquid lets go of heat.
senses.whyCN: 液体放下热，秩序就出现了。

senses.title: Fine glassware
senses.definition: glass of high quality, or objects made of it
senses.definitionCN: 高质量玻璃或用水晶制成的器物
senses.example: They drank from tall crystal glasses.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用高脚水晶杯喝酒。
senses.why: Purity of material shows in how it rings.
senses.whyCN: 材料纯不纯，听它敲响就知道。

intro.en: Crystal comes from Greek krystallos, ice, through Latin crystallum and Old French cristal.
intro.cn: crystal 源自希腊语 krystallos（冰），经拉丁语 crystallum 与古法语 cristal 进入英语。

items.en: Krystallos meant ice.
items.cn: krystallos 意为冰。

items.en: It was used for clear rock that looked like frozen water.
items.cn: 它被用来指像冻住的水一样的透明石头。

items.en: Crystallum kept both the ice and the clear stone senses.
items.cn: crystallum 同时保留冰与透明石头两层意思。

items.en: Cristal named clear stone and fine glass.
items.cn: cristal 指透明石头与精细玻璃。

items.en: Crystal meant a clear mineral with flat faces.
items.cn: crystal 指带平面棱的透明矿物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the crystall- stem or the cr- opening, and the meaning group names other clear solids.
note.cn: 形近组共享 crystall- 词干或 cr- 开头，近义组列出其他透明固体的说法。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with frozen water that never melts and end with a glass that sings.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一块永不融化的冰开始，落到一只会唱的水晶杯。

normal.en: The Greeks called clear stone ice, and the name stuck.
normal.cn: 希腊人把透明石头叫作冰，这名字就留下了。

normal.en: Light goes in white and comes out in colors.
normal.cn: 光白白地进去，出来时带了颜色。

normal.en: Salt and sugar build the same shape, smaller.
normal.cn: 盐和糖也会长出同样的形状，只是更小。

normal.en: Tap a crystal glass and hear how pure it is.
normal.cn: 敲一下水晶杯，就听得出它有多纯。

normal.en: A crystal is order you can hold in your hand.
normal.cn: 水晶是能握在手里的秩序。

abstract.en: Picture a stone with edges sharp as cut glass.
abstract.cn: 想象一块棱边像切玻璃一样锋利的石头。

abstract.en: Picture a thin rainbow lying on a white wall.
abstract.cn: 想象白墙上一道细细的彩虹。

abstract.en: Picture a snowflake that kept its shape all year.
abstract.cn: 想象一片整年都没化掉的雪花。

examples.en: The cave is full of tall crystal columns.
examples.cn: 洞穴里满是高大的水晶柱。

examples.en: These crystals grow slowly in cold water.
examples.cn: 这些晶体在冷水里慢慢长成。

examples.en: She poured the juice into a crystal glass.
examples.cn: 她把果汁倒进一只水晶杯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crystal 记成「冻住的光」：希腊人叫它冰（krystallos），透明石头就像冻住的水。

root: 源自希腊语 krystallos（冰），经拉丁语 crystallum 与古法语 cristal 进入英语；本义是像冻住的水一样透明的石头，后指水晶、结晶与水晶玻璃。

sensesIntro.en: From a clear mineral, to a regular solid form, to fine glass that rings.
sensesIntro.cn: 从透明矿物，到规则的固体形态，再到敲之有声的精细玻璃。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clear stone splitting sunlight into colors.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块透明石头把阳光分成几种颜色。

branches.en: The stone is valued because light can cross it.
branches.cn: 这块石头珍贵，是因为光能穿过它。

branches.en: Small particles line up and repeat the same shape.
branches.cn: 小颗粒排好队，一遍遍重复同一形状。

branches.en: Fine glass carries the same name in a cup.
branches.cn: 精细玻璃做成杯子，也叫这个名字。

branches.en: The big stone and the small grain share one order.
branches.cn: 大石头与小颗粒共享同一种秩序。

branches.en: Clear stone and clear glass both let light speak.
branches.cn: 透明石头与透明玻璃都让光说话。

intro.en: Crystal grows a family of words for clear stone, regular shapes, and the act of forming them.
intro.cn: crystal 长出一族词，关于透明石头、规则形状以及形成它们的过程。

latinIntro.en: The Greek krystallos, ice, is the root under crystal and crystalline.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 krystallos（冰）是 crystal 与 crystalline 背后的根。

items.example: The crystal is cut with many faces.
items.exampleCN: 这块水晶切出很多棱面。

items.example: The rock has a crystalline structure.
Sugar will crystallize as it cools.
The lake water is crystal clear.

items.meaning: a glass ball used by fortune tellers
items.example: She looked into a crystal ball.

items.meaning: clear quartz in its natural form
items.example: Rock crystal was once prized as ice.

definition_zh: 立方体；立方；切成小方块
definition_en: a solid shape with six equal square faces, or to cut food into blocks
core_image: 一颗骰子停在桌面上，每个面都是正方形
scene: 骰子停在桌角，朝上一面正好是正方形。Cut the bread into small cubes before drying it.
sceneCN: 这里 cube 指「立方体」（第 1 个义项：六个面都是正方形的立体）；句意是先把面包切成小方块再烘干。

senses.title: A six-sided solid
senses.definition: a solid with six equal square faces
senses.definitionCN: 六个相等的正方形面构成的立体
senses.example: The box is a perfect cube.
senses.exampleCN: 这个盒子是一个完整的立方体。
senses.why: Every face agrees with the other five.
senses.whyCN: 每个面都和另外五个面一样。

senses.title: A third power
senses.definition: the number you get by multiplying a number by itself twice
senses.definitionCN: 把一个数自乘两次所得的数
senses.example: The cube of three is twenty-seven.
senses.exampleCN: 三的立方是二十七。
senses.why: Three equal lengths fill one solid space.
senses.whyCN: 三段相等的长度填满一个立体。

senses.title: Cut into blocks
senses.definition: to cut something into small cube shapes
senses.definitionCN: 把某物切成小方块
senses.example: Cube the potatoes before frying them.
senses.exampleCN: 炸之前把土豆切成小方块。
senses.why: A knife turns soft food into geometry.
senses.whyCN: 刀把软的食物切成几何形。

intro.en: Cube comes from Greek kybos, a die, through Latin cubus and French cube.
intro.cn: cube 源自希腊语 kybos（骰子），经拉丁语 cubus 与法语 cube 进入英语。

items.en: Kybos meant a cube or a dice.
items.cn: kybos 指立方体或骰子。

items.en: It also described a piled heap of grain.
items.cn: 它也能形容堆起的谷堆。

items.en: Cubus kept the shape of the six-faced solid.
items.cn: cubus 保留了六面立体的形状。

items.en: Cube named the solid with equal square faces.
items.cn: cube 指各面为相等正方形的立体。

items.en: Cube entered English and later named a third power.
items.cn: cube 进入英语，后来也指三次方。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cu- opening, and the meaning group names other solid blocks.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cu- 开头，近义组列出其他实心块状物的说法。

entries.definition: the raised edge of a road
a solid piece with flat sides
a small cube used in games
a shape with length, width, and height

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a die on a table and end with potatoes under a knife.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从桌上一颗骰子开始，落到刀下的土豆。

normal.en: Six squares, all the same, make one cube.
normal.cn: 六个一样的正方形，做成一个立方体。

normal.en: A die is just a cube that learned to roll.
normal.cn: 骰子就是一个学会打滚的立方体。

normal.en: Multiply a number by itself twice and you cube it.
normal.cn: 把一个数自乘两次，就是求它的立方。

normal.en: Soup tastes better when the vegetables are cubed.
normal.cn: 蔬菜切成小块，汤就更好喝。

normal.en: A cube has no front and no back, only faces.
normal.cn: 立方体没有前后，只有一个个面。

abstract.en: Picture a sugar lump melting in a hot cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一块方糖在热杯里化开。

abstract.en: Picture three equal sticks filling one box.
abstract.cn: 想象三根等长的棍子填满一个盒子。

abstract.en: Picture a tray of potatoes cut into squares.
abstract.cn: 想象一盘切成方块的土豆。

examples.en: The ice in the glass is one large cube.
examples.cn: 杯里的冰是一大块立方体。

examples.en: Cube the cheese and add it to the salad.
examples.cn: 把奶酪切成小块加进沙拉。

examples.en: The cube of four is sixty-four.
examples.cn: 四的立方是六十四。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cube 记成「骰子」：希腊语 kybos 就是骰子，六个面一样大。

root: 源自希腊语 kybos（骰子、立方体），经拉丁语 cubus 与法语 cube 进入英语；本义是六面相等的骰子形，后指数学上的立方与切成方块。

sensesIntro.en: From a six-sided solid, to a third power, to food cut into blocks.
sensesIntro.cn: 从六面的立体，到三次方，再到切成方块的食物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a die resting on a table, every face a square.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗骰子停在桌上，每个面都是正方形。

branches.en: Six equal squares fold into one solid.
branches.cn: 六个相等的正方形围成一个立体。

branches.en: Two multiplications turn a length into a volume.
branches.cn: 两次相乘，把长度变成体积。

branches.en: A knife repeats the same shape in food.
branches.cn: 刀在食物上重复同一种形状。

branches.en: The shape and the power carry one name.
branches.cn: 形状和乘方共用一个名字。

branches.en: A whole cube and a small piece of it look alike.
branches.cn: 整块立方体与它的小块长得很像。

intro.en: Cube forms a small family for shape, power, and cutting things into blocks.
intro.cn: cube 组成一小族词，关于形状、乘方与切成方块。

latinIntro.en: The Greek kybos, a die, is the root behind cube and cubic.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 kybos（骰子）是 cube 与 cubic 背后的根。

items.exampleCN: 每个立方体有十二条棱。

items.example: The room is ten cubic metres.
A cubical box sat on the floor.
items.exampleCN: 地板上放着一只方形箱子。

items.meaning: the number that gives a cube
items.example: The cube root of eight is two.
He dropped a sugar cube in the tea.
items.exampleCN: 他往茶里放了一块方糖。

items.meaning: a small block of ice for drinks
items.example: Add two ice cubes to the glass.

items.meaning: an art style built from simple shapes
items.meaningCN: 以简单几何形构成的艺术风格
items.example: Cubism broke faces into flat shapes.
items.exampleCN: 立体主义把人脸拆成平面形状。

definition_en: a signal that tells someone to begin, or the long stick used in billiards
core_image: 舞台侧幕里有人悄悄抬起手，演员立刻开口
scene: 舞台侧幕里一只手轻轻抬起，演员随即开口。The light was her cue to walk on stage.
sceneCN: 这里 cue 指「提示」（第 1 个义项：示意某人开始动作或说话）；句意是灯光就是她上台的提示。

senses.title: A signal to act
senses.definition: a signal that tells someone to begin or to speak
senses.definitionCN: 示意某人开始或说话的信号
senses.example: The bell was our cue to leave.
senses.exampleCN: 铃声就是我们离开的信号。
senses.why: A small sign can set a whole action going.
senses.whyCN: 一个小小的信号，能带动一整套动作。

senses.title: A hint from others
senses.definition: a hint about what to do, taken from someone else
senses.definitionCN: 从别人那里得到的做法暗示
senses.example: He took his cue from the older players.
senses.exampleCN: 他照着年长球员的做法行事。
senses.why: We learn the next move by watching a neighbour.
senses.whyCN: 看着旁边的人，就学会了下一步。

senses.title: The stick in billiards
senses.definition: the long stick used to hit the ball in billiards
senses.definitionCN: 台球中用来击球的长杆
senses.example: She chalked her cue before the shot.
senses.exampleCN: 击球前她给球杆上了粉。
senses.why: A long wooden arm reaches where a hand cannot.
senses.whyCN: 一条木头长臂，伸到手够不到的地方。

intro.en: Cue may come from Latin quando, when, written in scripts to mark the moment an actor begins.
intro.cn: cue 可能出自拉丁语 quando（何时），写在剧本上标记演员开口的时刻。

items.en: Quando meant when, a word written in the margin of a script.
items.cn: quando 意为何时，常写在剧本页边。

items.en: Actors used the letter q for quando at the point of entry.
items.cn: 演员在入场处用字母 q 代表 quando。

items.en: Cue named the words just before an actor spoke.
items.cn: cue 指演员开口前的那几句词。

items.en: It widened to any signal that starts an action.
items.cn: 它扩展为任何启动动作的信号。

items.en: The billiard cue came separately from queue, a tail.
items.cn: 台球杆另出自法语 queue（尾巴）。

items.en: One spelling now covers a stage signal and a stick.
items.cn: 如今一个拼写既指舞台信号，也指球杆。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -ue ending, and the meaning group names other signals that start something.
note.cn: 形近组共享 -ue 结尾，近义组列出其他启动某事的信号。

entries.definition: to make a sick person well
a fact that helps solve a problem
entries.definitionCN: 有助于解开问题的线索

entries.definition: a sign that tells people what to do
entries.definitionCN: 告诉人该如何做的信号

entries.definition: a word said to help someone continue

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a hand in the wings and end with a stick on green cloth.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从侧幕里的一只手开始，落到绿布上的一根杆。

normal.en: A cue is a small sign that starts a big action.
normal.cn: cue 是启动大动作的小信号。

normal.en: The letter q in the script means you speak now.
normal.cn: 剧本里的字母 q 就是轮到你说话。

normal.en: Watch others and take your cue from them.
normal.cn: 看着别人，从他们那里得到提示。

normal.en: Miss the cue and the scene moves on without you.
normal.cn: 错过提示，戏就把你落下往前走了。

normal.en: The same sound names a stick that starts a shot.
normal.cn: 同一个音也指启动一杆的球杆。

abstract.en: Picture a finger lifting in the dark wings.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗侧幕里一根手指抬起。

abstract.en: Picture an actor breathing in before the first line.
abstract.cn: 想象演员在开口前吸一口气。

abstract.en: Picture chalk dust on the tip of a cue.
abstract.cn: 想象球杆头上的一点粉。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a cue to begin.
examples.cn: 老师给了我们开始的提示。

examples.en: He took his cue from her silence and left.
examples.cn: 他从她的沉默里得到暗示，离开了。

examples.en: She laid the cue gently on the table.
examples.cn: 她把球杆轻轻放在桌上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cue 记成「该你了」：剧本边上一个字母 q，就是演员开口的时刻。

root: 可能出自拉丁语 quando（何时），剧本里以字母 q 标记演员开口之处；本义是开口前的提示词，后泛指任何启动动作的信号。台球杆一义另来自法语 queue（尾巴）。

sensesIntro.en: From a stage signal, to any borrowed hint, to the stick that starts a shot.
sensesIntro.cn: 从舞台信号，到任何借来的暗示，再到启动一杆的球杆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand raised in the wings, an actor stepping out.
core.cn: 核心意象：侧幕里一只手抬起，演员迈步出场。

branches.en: A signal tells a person that the moment has come.
branches.cn: 一个信号告诉人，时刻到了。

branches.en: A hint is a cue borrowed from someone else.
branches.cn: 暗示是从别人那里借来的提示。

branches.en: The stick carries the old meaning of a starting point.
branches.cn: 球杆保留着「起点」这层旧义。

branches.en: Both a stage signal and a borrowed hint push us forward.
branches.cn: 舞台信号与借来的暗示都推我们往前。

branches.en: Neither hint nor stick works without a hand to use it.
branches.cn: 暗示与球杆，都要有手来用才生效。

intro.en: Cue forms a small set of words for signals, prompts, and the tools of the game.
intro.cn: cue 组成一小族词，关于信号、提示与这项运动的器具。

latinIntro.en: The Latin quando, when, is the likely root under the stage sense of cue.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quando（何时）可能是 cue 舞台义背后的根。

items.meaning: a card showing words to say
items.example: He read from a cue card.
Cueing is done from the side.

items.meaning: to give someone the needed information
items.example: Cue him in before the meeting.

items.meaningCN: 错误或时机不对的提示

items.meaning: the ball struck first in billiards
items.meaningCN: 台球中先被击中的主球
items.example: He aimed the cue ball at the red.

items.meaning: the long stick used in billiards
items.example: The cue stick rested on the table.

definition_en: to prepare land and grow crops, or to help a skill or friendship develop
core_image: 一个人弯着腰在土里松土，旁边是刚冒芽的小苗
scene: 他弯着腰在田里松土，脚边是刚冒芽的小苗。Farmers cultivate this field twice a year.
sceneCN: 这里 cultivate 指「耕种」（第 1 个义项：翻土并种植作物）；句意是农民每年耕种这块地两次。

senses.title: Work the land
senses.definition: to prepare land and grow crops on it
senses.definitionCN: 翻整土地并在上面种作物
senses.example: They cultivate rice in these fields.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在这些田里种稻。
senses.why: The ground gives back what care is put into it.
senses.whyCN: 土地会回报你放进去的照料。

senses.title: Grow a quality
senses.definition: to help a skill or habit grow over time
senses.definitionCN: 让某种技能或习惯随时间成长
senses.example: Reading cultivates a steady mind.
senses.exampleCN: 阅读培养沉稳的心。
senses.why: A habit is a seed that needs daily water.
senses.whyCN: 习惯是一颗需要每天浇水的种子。

senses.title: Build a relationship
senses.definition: to spend care on a friendship or useful contact
senses.definitionCN: 用心经营友谊或有用的关系
senses.example: He cultivated friends in many cities.
senses.exampleCN: 他在许多城市结交朋友。
senses.why: People, like plants, grow where they are tended.
senses.whyCN: 人和植物一样，在被照料的地方生长。

intro.en: Cultivate comes from Latin cultivare, to till, from colere, to till or to honour.
intro.cn: cultivate 源自拉丁语 cultivare（耕作），更早出自 colere（耕种、敬奉）。

items.en: Colere meant to till the soil and to honour a god.
items.cn: colere 指耕种土地，也指敬奉神灵。

items.en: Cultivare meant to work the land with care.
items.cn: cultivare 指用心整治土地。

items.en: It also described caring for the mind.
items.cn: 它也能形容对心智的照料。

items.en: Cultivate meant to till fields and gardens.
items.cn: cultivate 指耕作田地与园子。

items.en: It extended to manners, skills, and friends.
items.cn: 它扩展到举止、技能与朋友。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cultiv- stem, and the meaning group names other kinds of careful growth.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cultiv- 词干，近义组列出其他用心培育的说法。

entries.definitionCN: 举止受过训练而文雅的

entries.definition: of the way a people lives
a small group with strong beliefs
to care for something as it grows
to grow stronger or fuller over time
entries.definitionCN: 随时间变得更强或更完整

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a hand in the soil and end with a friendship kept for years.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从土里的一只手开始，落到维系多年的友谊。

normal.en: Cultivate is care repeated, not a single act.
normal.cn: cultivate 是反复的照料，不是一次性的动作。

normal.en: Turn the soil, drop the seed, wait.
normal.cn: 翻土，下种，然后等。

normal.en: A skill grows like a plant, on small daily water.
normal.cn: 本事像植物，靠每天一点点水长大。

normal.en: You can cultivate beans, a habit, or a friend.
normal.cn: 你可以种豆，也可以培养习惯或结交朋友。

normal.en: Whatever is cultivated stops being wild.
normal.cn: 被栽培过的东西，就不再是野生的。

abstract.en: Picture a hoe turning dark soil in the morning.
abstract.cn: 想象清晨一把锄头翻起黑土。

abstract.en: Picture a green shoot beside a careful hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一只谨慎的手旁有一株绿芽。

abstract.en: Picture two people meeting again after years.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人多年后再次相见。

examples.en: They cultivate vegetables behind the house.
examples.cn: 他们在屋后种菜。

examples.en: She cultivated the habit of walking at dawn.
examples.cn: 她养成了天亮散步的习惯。

examples.en: Good leaders cultivate the people around them.
examples.cn: 好的领导者培养身边的人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cultivate 记成「照料」：cult 是耕种，反复照料，土地和本事都会长。

root: 源自拉丁语 cultivare（耕作），更早出自 colere（耕种、敬奉）；本义是翻土种地，后引申为培养能力、习惯与人际关系。

sensesIntro.en: From working the soil, to growing a skill, to tending a friendship.
sensesIntro.cn: 从整治土地，到培养本事，再到经营友谊。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand loosening soil around a young shoot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手在新苗周围松土。

branches.en: Land must be broken and planted before it feeds anyone.
branches.cn: 土地要先翻开放种，才能养活人。

branches.en: A skill is watered in small amounts every day.
branches.cn: 本事靠每天一点点的浇灌。

branches.en: Friendship is a plant that needs regular care.
branches.cn: 友谊是一株需要常常照料的植物。

branches.en: Soil and mind answer the same kind of care.
branches.cn: 土地与心智回应同一种照料。

branches.en: Habits and friendships both die when neglected.
branches.cn: 习惯与友谊一旦荒废都会死去。

intro.en: Cultivate belongs to the Latin colere family, which also gives culture and agriculture.
intro.cn: cultivate 属于拉丁语 colere 一族，culture 与 agriculture 也出自这里。

latinIntro.en: The Latin colere, to till and to honour, is the root under cultivation and culture.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 colere（耕种、敬奉）是 cultivation 与 culture 背后的根。

items.meaning: the act of tilling or developing
a person or machine that tills
items.example: The cultivator broke the hard soil.
Uncultivated land lay beyond the fence.

items.meaning: the way a people lives and thinks
items.meaningCN: 一个族群的生存与思维方式
items.exampleCN: 文化塑造我们打招呼的方式。

items.meaning: of a people's way of life
items.example: The city has a rich cultural life.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市文化生活丰富。

definition_en: relating to the way of life, art, and beliefs of a group of people
core_image: 一条老街上，戏台、书店和庙挤在同一条巷子里
scene: 老街上戏台、书店和庙挤在一条巷子里，都是这座城的样子。The festival is the cultural heart of the town.
sceneCN: 这里 cultural 指「文化的」（第 1 个义项：与一个群体的生活方式、艺术和信仰有关）；句意是这个节庆是这座镇的文化核心。

senses.title: Of a way of life
senses.definition: relating to the customs and beliefs of a group
senses.definitionCN: 与一个群体的习俗和信仰有关的
senses.example: Food is a cultural matter, not just a physical one.
senses.exampleCN: 饮食是文化问题，不只是生理问题。
senses.why: What a group repeats becomes its way of life.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体反复做的事，就成了它的生活方式。

senses.title: Of art and learning
senses.definition: relating to art, music, books, and learning
senses.definitionCN: 与艺术、音乐、书籍和学问有关的
senses.example: The city offers many cultural events.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市有很多文艺活动。
senses.why: A society keeps its best made things on show.
senses.whyCN: 一个社会把做得最好的东西摆出来给人看。

senses.title: Of refined taste
senses.definition: showing refined taste and education
senses.definitionCN: 表现出修养与教育的
senses.example: She moves in cultural circles.
senses.exampleCN: 她出入有文化气息的圈子。
senses.why: Training of the mind leaves a visible mark.
senses.whyCN: 心智受过训练，会留下看得见的痕迹。

intro.en: Cultural is Latin cultura, tilling, plus -alis, belonging to; English formed it in the nineteenth century.
intro.cn: cultural 由拉丁语 cultura（耕种）加 -alis（属于）构成，十九世纪在英语中成形。

items.en: Cultura meant tilling the soil and giving care.
items.cn: cultura 指耕种土地并加以照料。

items.en: -Alis meant belonging to or relating to.
items.cn: -alis 意为属于或关于。

items.en: Cultural first meant of cultivation, of land or mind.
items.cn: cultural 最初指耕种或心智培养的。

items.en: It shifted to the arts and way of life of a people.
items.cn: 它转向一个群体的艺术与生活方式。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a narrow street holding a stage and a temple and end with a trained eye.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一条挤着戏台与庙的窄巷开始，落到一双受过训练的眼睛。

normal.en: Culture plus -al makes an adjective about a whole way of life.
normal.cn: culture 加 -al，成了描述整套生活方式的形容词。

normal.en: A festival can be the heart of a town.
normal.cn: 一个节庆可以是一座镇的心脏。

normal.en: Cultural things are learned from others, not carried in blood.
normal.cn: 文化的东西是向别人学来的，不写在血里。

normal.en: Food, dress, and songs all carry culture.
normal.cn: 饮食、服饰与歌都带着文化。

normal.en: A cultured person shows what a culture trained.
normal.cn: 有修养的人，显出文化训练过的痕迹。

abstract.en: Picture a stage lit beside a small bookshop.
abstract.cn: 想象一座亮着灯的戏台挨着小小书店。

abstract.en: Picture hands passing food across a long table.
abstract.cn: 想象一双手把食物递过长桌。

abstract.en: Picture a child copying a dance step.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子跟着学舞步。

examples.en: The two countries began a cultural exchange.
examples.cn: 两国开始了文化交流。

examples.en: Old songs are part of our cultural heritage.
examples.cn: 老歌是我们文化遗产的一部分。

examples.en: The town has a busy cultural life.
examples.cn: 这镇的文化生活很热闹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cultural 记成「种出来的」：culture 原是耕种，一个群体长期养出的习惯与艺术，就是文化。

root: 由拉丁语 cultura（耕种、照料）加形容词后缀 -alis 构成；十九世纪进入英语，本义与栽培有关，后指一个群体的艺术、信仰与生活方式。

sensesIntro.en: From a group's way of life, to its arts, to a refined manner.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一个群体的生活方式，到它的艺术，再到文雅的举止。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stage, a bookshop, and a temple in one narrow street.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条窄巷里同时有戏台、书店和庙。

branches.en: Customs shared by a group are called cultural.
branches.cn: 一个群体共享的习俗被称为文化的。

branches.en: Art and learning are the visible face of that life.
branches.cn: 艺术与学问是这种生活看得见的脸。

branches.en: A trained taste shows culture in one person.
branches.cn: 受过训练的品味，把文化显在一个人身上。

branches.en: A way of life and its art cannot be separated.
branches.cn: 生活方式与它的艺术分不开。

branches.en: What a society makes, a person can learn to love.
branches.cn: 社会做出来的东西，个人可以学着去爱。

intro.en: Cultural sits in the Latin cultura family, with culture, cultured, and agriculture around it.
intro.cn: cultural 属于拉丁语 cultura 一族，周围有 culture、cultured 与 agriculture。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cultura, tilling, is the root that carries -al into cultural.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cultura（耕种）是把 -al 带进 cultural 的根。

items.exampleCN: 从文化上说，这两座镇不同。
伦敦是座多元文化城市。
社会与文化的力量塑造品味。

definition_zh: 文化；文艺；（细菌等的）培养物
definition_en: the way of life of a people, or cells and bacteria grown for study
core_image: 一张长桌上摆着不同人家的饭菜，各有各的做法
scene: 长桌上摆着好几户人家的饭菜，做法各不一样。Food is one of the clearest signs of a culture.
sceneCN: 这里 culture 指「文化」（第 1 个义项：一个群体共同的生活方式与观念）；句意是饮食是文化最清楚的标志之一。

senses.title: A people's way of life
senses.definition: the customs and beliefs shared by a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 一个群体共享的习俗与信念
senses.example: Every culture has its own rules of politeness.
senses.exampleCN: 每种文化都有自己的礼貌规矩。
senses.why: A group agrees on what to say, eat, and honour.
senses.whyCN: 一群人约好怎么说、怎么吃、敬什么。

senses.title: Art and learning
senses.definition: the arts, music, and learning of a society
senses.definitionCN: 一个社会的艺术、音乐与学问
senses.example: The museum is a storehouse of culture.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆是文化的仓库。
senses.why: A society keeps what it wants to remember.
senses.whyCN: 一个社会把想记住的东西收起来。

senses.title: Growing cells
senses.definition: cells or bacteria grown for study
senses.definitionCN: 为研究而培养的细胞或细菌
senses.example: The lab keeps a culture of the bacteria.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室保存着这种细菌的培养物。
senses.why: Life can be coaxed to grow in a dish.
senses.whyCN: 生命可以被哄着在皿里长起来。

intro.en: Culture comes from Latin cultura, tilling, from colere, to till and to honour.
intro.cn: culture 源自拉丁语 cultura（耕种），其根是 colere（耕种、敬奉）。

items.en: Colere meant to till the soil and to honour.
items.cn: colere 指耕种土地，也指敬奉。

items.en: Cultura named the tilling and the care it needs.
items.cn: cultura 指耕种以及所需的照料。

items.en: Culture first meant the tilling of land.
items.cn: culture 最初指耕地。

items.en: It moved to the training of the mind.
items.cn: 它转向心智的培养。

items.en: It named the arts and way of life of a people.
items.cn: 它指一个群体的艺术与生活方式。

items.en: It also meant growing bacteria in a lab.
items.cn: 它也指在实验室培养细菌。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cult- stem, and the meaning group names other words for a shared way of life.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cult- 词干，近义组列出其他表示共同生活方式的说法。

entries.definition: of the way of life of a group
a small group with strong beliefs
an advanced stage of social life
a usual way of doing something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a long table of food and end with a dish of growing cells.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一张摆满食物的长桌开始，落到一皿正在生长的细胞。

normal.en: Culture began as a word for digging in the soil.
normal.cn: culture 最初是刨土的字眼。

normal.en: What we eat says where we come from.
normal.cn: 我们吃什么，说明我们从哪里来。

normal.en: A museum keeps what a society chose to remember.
normal.cn: 博物馆收着一个社会选择记住的东西。

normal.en: The lab grows a culture the way a garden grows beans.
normal.cn: 实验室培养细菌，像园子种豆。

normal.en: Culture is learned, shared, and passed on.
normal.cn: 文化是学来的、共享的、传下去的。

abstract.en: Picture many hands reaching across one table.
abstract.cn: 想象许多只手伸过同一张桌子。

abstract.en: Picture a dish of clear jelly on a lab bench.
abstract.cn: 想象实验台上一皿透明的胶状物。

abstract.en: Picture a song taught to a child without a book.
abstract.cn: 想象一首不用书就教给孩子的歌。

examples.en: She studies the culture of mountain villages.
examples.cn: 她研究山村的文化。

examples.en: The lab grew a culture from a single cell.
examples.cn: 实验室从单个细胞培养出培养物。

examples.en: Music is central to their culture.
examples.cn: 音乐在他们的文化中处于中心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 culture 记成「耕种」：拉丁语 colere 是耕地，心里的东西也要一季季种出来。

root: 源自拉丁语 cultura（耕种、照料），其根是 colere（耕种、敬奉）；本义是种地，后指心智的培养，再指一个群体的艺术、信仰与生活方式，也指实验室里的培养物。

sensesIntro.en: From tilling the land, to training the mind, to a whole way of life.
sensesIntro.cn: 从种地，到培养心智，再到整套生活方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: many dishes from many homes on one long table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张长桌上摆着许多人家各不相同的菜。

branches.en: A group that shares habits and beliefs has a culture.
branches.cn: 共享习惯与信念的群体，就有文化。

branches.en: Its art and learning are stored and shown.
branches.cn: 它的艺术与学问被收藏并展示。

branches.en: A lab grows life in a dish and calls it a culture.
branches.cn: 实验室在皿里养出生命，也叫 culture。

branches.en: Both a people and a dish are tended until they grow.
branches.cn: 人群与培养皿都要照料才会生长。

branches.en: Keeping and growing are two sides of the same word.
branches.cn: 收藏与培养是同一个词的两面。

intro.en: Culture is the parent word for cultural, cultured, and a wide family of compounds.
intro.cn: culture 是 cultural、cultured 以及一大族合成词的母词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin colere, to till, is the root under culture and its whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 colere（耕种）是 culture 及其整族词背后的根。

items.exampleCN: 文化是学来的，不是天生的。

items.example: They are culturing cells in the lab.
items.exampleCN: 他们正在实验室培养细胞。

items.meaning: a small culture inside a larger one
items.exampleCN: 滑板者形成一个亚文化。

items.meaning: a culture against the main one
items.exampleCN: 反主流文化拒绝旧规矩。

definition_en: a small round container for drinking, the amount it holds, or a prize cup
core_image: 两只手捧着一只热杯，杯口冒着白气
scene: 两只手捧着一只热杯，杯口还冒着白气。She filled the cup with hot tea and held it close.
sceneCN: 这里 cup 指「杯子」（第 1 个义项：喝水用的小圆容器）；句意是她把杯子倒满热茶，捧在手里。

senses.title: A drinking container
senses.definition: a small round container used for drinking
senses.definitionCN: 用来喝水的小圆容器
senses.example: He put the cup beside the plate.
senses.exampleCN: 他把杯子放在盘子旁。
senses.why: A hand needs something round to hold hot liquid.
senses.whyCN: 手需要一个圆东西来端住热水。

senses.title: The amount it holds
senses.definition: the amount that a cup holds
senses.definitionCN: 一只杯子能装的量
senses.example: Add two cups of flour.
senses.exampleCN: 加两杯面粉。
senses.why: A container becomes a unit of measure.
senses.whyCN: 容器本身变成了计量单位。

senses.title: A prize
senses.definition: a prize shaped like a cup, or a contest that awards one
senses.definitionCN: 杯形奖品，或颁发此奖的比赛
senses.example: The team raised the cup above their heads.
senses.exampleCN: 球队把奖杯举过头顶。
senses.why: A shared cup once marked a shared honour.
senses.whyCN: 共用的杯子，曾标记共同的荣誉。

intro.en: Cup comes from Old English cuppe, from Latin cuppa, a drinking vessel.
intro.cn: cup 源自古英语 cuppe，更早出自拉丁语 cuppa（饮器）。

items.en: Cuppa meant a drinking vessel.
items.cn: cuppa 指饮水的容器。

items.en: Cupa meant a tub or a barrel.
items.cn: cupa 指盆或桶。

items.en: Cuppe came into English with the Latin word.
items.cn: cuppe 随拉丁词进入英语。

items.en: Cup also meant the amount it could hold.
items.cn: cup 也指它能装的量。

items.en: A decorated cup became a prize for a winner.
items.cn: 装饰过的杯子成了给胜者的奖品。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short cu- shape, and the meaning group names other things you drink from or win.
note.cn: 形近组共享短小的 cu- 形状，近义组列出其他饮具或奖品。

a police officer, in informal speech
a large cup with a handle
a cup made of clear material

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with warm steam and end with a silver prize held high.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从热腾腾的白气开始，落到被高高举起的银杯。

normal.en: Two hands make the shape of a cup before a cup exists.
normal.cn: 杯子还不存在时，双手已经围出杯子的形状。

normal.en: A cup is a measure as soon as it holds something.
normal.cn: 杯子一装东西，就成了量具。

normal.en: Hot tea needs a handle or a pair of hands.
normal.cn: 热茶需要把手，或者一双手。

normal.en: A prize cup is a cup you cannot drink from.
normal.cn: 奖杯是一只你没法用来喝水的杯子。

normal.en: Fill it, hold it, empty it, wash it.
normal.cn: 倒满，捧住，喝空，洗净。

abstract.en: Picture steam curling above a thick white rim.
abstract.cn: 想象白气从厚厚的杯口卷起。

abstract.en: Picture a spoon standing in a cup of flour.
abstract.cn: 想象一把勺子立在一杯面粉里。

abstract.en: Picture a silver cup with many names cut into it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只刻满名字的银杯。

examples.en: She poured a cup of tea for each guest.
examples.cn: 她给每位客人倒了一杯茶。

examples.en: The bowl and the cup are both broken.
examples.cn: 碗和杯子都碎了。

examples.en: Our team won the cup last year.
examples.cn: 我们队去年赢得了奖杯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cup 记成「围起来的手心」：两只手一合，就成了能盛水的形状。

root: 源自古英语 cuppe，更早出自拉丁语 cuppa（饮器）；本义是喝水的小容器，后引申为一杯之量与杯形奖品。

sensesIntro.en: From a vessel in the hand, to a measure in a recipe, to a prize on a shelf.
sensesIntro.cn: 从手里的容器，到食谱里的量，再到架上的奖品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands around a warm cup with steam above it.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手捧着一只热杯，杯口冒着白气。

branches.en: A round vessel fits a hand and holds a drink.
branches.cn: 圆容器贴合手，也装得住饮料。

branches.en: Once it holds a known amount, it becomes a measure.
branches.cn: 一旦装着已知的量，它就成了量具。

branches.en: A cup with no drink becomes a prize.
branches.cn: 不装饮料的杯子，成了奖品。

branches.en: The thing and the amount share one short word.
branches.cn: 容器与分量共用一个短词。

branches.en: Both a measure and a prize are held up for all to see.
branches.cn: 量杯与奖杯都会被举起来给人看。

intro.en: Cup forms compounds for small vessels, measures, and a famous prize.
intro.cn: cup 组成一族合成词，关于小容器、量与大奖。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cuppa, a drinking vessel, is the root behind cup and cupboard.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cuppa（饮器）是 cup 与 cupboard 背后的根。

items.example: The cup is full of milk.
A teacup sat on the saucer.

items.meaning: a small cake baked in a paper cup
items.exampleCN: 她把纸杯蛋糕带到学校。

items.meaning: a support that holds a cup

The World Cup is held every four years.
items.exampleCN: 世界杯每四年举办一次。

definition_en: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves, used for dishes or food
core_image: 一扇木柜门打开，里面叠着碗和杯子
scene: 厨房里那扇木门一开，里面叠着碗和杯。The plates are kept in the cupboard above the sink.
sceneCN: 这里 cupboard 指「碗柜」（第 1 个义项：带门和架子、用来放餐具的家具）；句意是盘子放在水槽上方的碗柜里。

senses.title: A storage cabinet
senses.definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for dishes or food
senses.definitionCN: 带门和架子、放餐具或食物的家具
senses.example: Put the bowls back in the cupboard.
senses.exampleCN: 把碗放回碗柜。
senses.why: Doors hide the clutter and keep dust out.
senses.whyCN: 柜门挡住杂乱，也挡住灰尘。

senses.title: A small closed space
senses.definition: a small closet built into a wall
senses.definitionCN: 嵌在墙里的小储藏空间
senses.example: The broom is in the cupboard under the stairs.
senses.exampleCN: 扫帚在楼梯下的壁橱里。
senses.why: A wall can hold a room no one counts.
senses.whyCN: 一堵墙里能藏一间没人算进去的小屋。

senses.title: A bare cupboard
senses.definition: a state of having no food or money left
senses.definitionCN: 食物或钱都已见底的状态
senses.example: After the long winter the cupboard was bare.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长的冬天过后，柜子空了。
senses.why: An empty shelf tells a whole story.
senses.whyCN: 一格空架子就能讲完一个故事。

intro.en: Cupboard began as Middle English cuppebord, a board for cups, from cup and bord.
intro.cn: cupboard 原是中古英语 cuppebord，即放杯子的板，由 cup 与 bord 合成。

items.en: Cuppebord joined cup and bord, a board.
items.cn: cuppebord 由 cup 与 bord（板）合成。

items.en: It meant a sideboard for cups and plates.
items.cn: 它指放杯盘的边柜。

items.en: The word was shortened to cupboard.
items.cn: 这个词被缩短成 cupboard。

items.en: Cupboards gained doors and became closed.
items.cn: 碗柜装上柜门，成了封闭的家具。

items.en: It now means any cabinet for dishes or food.
items.cn: 如今它指任何放餐具或食物的柜子。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cup- opening, and the meaning group names other closed storage furniture.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cup- 开头，近义组列出其他封闭的储物家具。

entries.definition: as much as a cupboard can hold

a piece of furniture with shelves and doors
a small room for storing things
a small cupboard that can be locked

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a board for cups and end with an empty shelf.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一块放杯子的板开始，落到一格空架子。

normal.en: Cup plus board: first a shelf, then a box.
normal.cn: cup 加 board：先是板，后来成了箱。

normal.en: The plates live above the sink, behind two small doors.

abstract.cn: 想象两扇小门打开，里面叠着碗。

abstract.en: Picture a broom leaning in a dark closet.
abstract.cn: 想象一把扫帚靠在黑暗的壁橱里。

abstract.en: Picture one empty shelf with a single crumb.
abstract.cn: 想象一格空架子上只有一点面包屑。

examples.en: The sugar is in the cupboard on the left.
examples.cn: 糖在左边的碗柜里。

examples.en: He built a cupboard for the kitchen.
examples.cn: 他为厨房做了一个橱柜。

examples.en: The cupboard was bare by the end of the month.
examples.cn: 到了月底，柜子已经空了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cupboard 记成「放杯子的板」：cup 加 board（板），一块放杯子的板，后来装上柜门。

sensesIntro.en: From a board for cups, to a closed cabinet, to an empty shelf that tells a story.
sensesIntro.cn: 从放杯子的板，到带门的柜子，再到能讲故事的空气架。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wooden door opening on stacked bowls and cups.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇木门打开，里面叠着碗和杯。

branches.en: A cabinet holds dishes behind closed doors.
branches.cn: 柜子把餐具收在关着的门后。

branches.en: A cupboard can also be a small room in a wall.
branches.cn: cupboard 也可以是墙里的小空间。

branches.en: A bare cupboard means there is nothing left.
branches.cn: 柜子空了，意味着什么都不剩。

branches.en: A big cupboard and a small closet both hide things.
branches.cn: 大碗柜与小壁橱都在藏东西。

branches.en: What is hidden may be dishes, or may be hunger.
branches.cn: 藏起来的可能是餐具，也可能是饥饿。

intro.en: Cupboard sits in the cup family, and keeps the old sense of a board in its spelling.
