latinIntro.en: The Latin cuppa, a drinking vessel, is the root behind cup and cupboard alike.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cuppa（饮器）是 cup 与 cupboard 共同的根。

items.example: The cupboard is full of bowls.

items.meaning: as much as a cupboard holds
items.example: They bought a cupboardful of rice.

items.meaning: affection shown for what one gets
items.example: The cat's purr was cupboard love.
items.exampleCN: 猫的呼噜是冲着食盆来的。

items.meaning: a small cake in a paper cup
items.exampleCN: 孩子吃了一个纸杯蛋糕。

items.example: The teacup has a thin handle.
The cup holder is beside the seat.

definition_en: to keep something under control, or the raised stone edge of a road
core_image: 一只手拉紧缰绳，让跑得太快的马慢下来
scene: 骑手拉紧缰绳，让跑得太快的马慢下来。The city hopes to curb the rise in traffic.
sceneCN: 这里 curb 指「抑制、控制」（第 1 个义项：让某事不再增长或加剧）；句意是这座城市希望抑制交通量的增长。

senses.title: Hold something back
senses.definition: to keep something from growing or getting worse
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某事增长或恶化
senses.example: New rules curb the use of plastic bags.
senses.exampleCN: 新规定限制塑料袋的使用。
senses.why: A strong force needs a bit to hold it.
senses.whyCN: 强大的力量需要一点东西勒住。

senses.title: The edge of a road
senses.definition: the raised stone edge along a road
senses.definitionCN: 路边凸起的石边
senses.example: She parked the car at the curb.
senses.exampleCN: 她把车停在路边。
senses.why: A low stone line keeps wheels off the grass.
senses.whyCN: 一条矮石线，把车轮挡在草外。

senses.title: A check or limit
senses.definition: a limit placed on something
senses.definitionCN: 加在某事上的限制
senses.example: The government put a curb on spending.
senses.exampleCN: 政府对开支设了限制。
senses.why: A curb is a line you are not meant to cross.
senses.whyCN: 路缘是一条不该越过的线。

intro.en: Curb comes from Old French courbe, curved, from Latin curvus, bent; a curb bit was a curved piece of metal for a horse.
intro.cn: curb 源自古法语 courbe（弯曲之物），更早出自拉丁语 curvus（弯的）；勒马的马衔就是一块弯金属。

items.en: Curvus meant bent or curved.
items.cn: curvus 意为弯曲的。

items.en: Courbe named something curved.
items.cn: courbe 指弯曲之物。

items.en: Curb first meant a curved bit for a horse.
items.cn: curb 最初指勒马的弯形马衔。

items.en: It came to mean a check or restraint.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示制止与约束。

items.en: It also named the stone edge of a street.
items.cn: 它也指街道边凸起的石缘。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- opening, and the meaning group names other ways of holding something back.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cur- 开头，近义组列出其他拉住某物的说法。

entries.definition: a solid with six square faces
to make a sick person well
to hold someone back from acting
entries.definitionCN: 拉住某人使其不作某事

entries.definition: to keep something below a level
entries.definitionCN: 使某事不超过某一水平

entries.definition: the outer line of a surface

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a pulled rein and end with a low stone line beside a road.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从被拉紧的缰绳开始，落到路边一条矮石线。

normal.en: A curb bit sits in a horse's mouth and asks it to slow.
normal.cn: 马衔放在马嘴里，请它慢下来。

normal.en: To curb a thing is to put a bit on it.
normal.cn: curb 一件事，就是给它套上嚼子。

normal.en: Curb the temper before it becomes a shout.
normal.cn: 在脾气变成喊声前先勒住它。

normal.en: The curb keeps cars off the grass.
normal.cn: 路缘把车挡在草地外。

normal.en: Every fast thing needs a small edge to stop it.
normal.cn: 每个太快的东西，都需要一道小边来挡住。

abstract.en: Picture a horse slowing as the reins go tight.
abstract.cn: 想象缰绳一紧，马就慢下来。

abstract.en: Picture a shoe stepping off a stone edge into the road.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鞋从石边踩下马路。

abstract.en: Picture a red line on a chart flattening out.
abstract.cn: 想象图上一根红线渐渐变平。

examples.en: The new tax is meant to curb waste.
examples.cn: 这项新税意在抑制浪费。

examples.en: He curbed his anger and spoke softly.
examples.cn: 他压住怒火，轻声说话。

examples.en: A bicycle lay against the curb.
examples.cn: 一辆自行车靠在路缘上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curb 记成「勒住」：马的弯曲嚼子勒住速度，就是抑制。

root: 源自古法语 courbe（弯曲之物），更早出自拉丁语 curvus（弯的）；本义是勒马的弯曲嚼子，后引申为约束与路缘。

sensesIntro.en: From pulling a horse back, to limiting a force, to a stone edge beside the road.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把马勒住，到限制一股力量，再到路边的石缘。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pulling a rein to slow a horse.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手拉紧缰绳让马慢下来。

branches.en: A check keeps a strong force from running away.
branches.cn: 约束让强大的力量不至于失控。

branches.en: The stone edge is a curb for wheels.
branches.cn: 石缘是给车轮设的路缘。

branches.en: A limit is a line drawn and kept.
branches.cn: 限制是一条画下并守住的线。

branches.en: To curb and to set a curb are the same act.
branches.cn: 抑制与设限是同一个动作。

branches.en: A road edge shows how a limit looks in stone.
branches.cn: 路缘把限制的样子用石头做出来。

intro.en: Curb forms words for restraining, for the horse bit, and for the stone edge of a street.
intro.cn: curb 组成一族词，关于抑制、马衔与街道石缘。

latinIntro.en: The Latin curvus, bent, is the root behind curb and its compounds.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 curvus（弯的）是 curb 及其合成词背后的根。

items.meaning: the stone edge of a road
the side of a road near the edge
a bit that controls a horse
items.example: The rider used a curb bit.

items.meaning: the weight of a car without load
how attractive a house looks from the street

items.exampleCN: 没有路缘的街道让车慢下来。

definition_en: to make a sick person well, or a treatment that ends a disease
core_image: 一碗苦药放在床头，喝完的人第二天能下床
scene: 床头的苦药喝完了，第二天那人就能下床。There is still no cure for that disease.
sceneCN: 这里 cure 指「疗法、治愈的手段」（第 1 个义项：能结束疾病的治疗方法）；句意是那种病至今仍没有疗法。

senses.title: Make well again
senses.definition: to make a sick person healthy again
senses.definitionCN: 使病人恢复健康
senses.example: The doctor cured him of the infection.
senses.exampleCN: 医生治好了他的感染。
senses.why: A body can be brought back to its own order.
senses.whyCN: 身体能被带回它本来的秩序。

senses.title: A treatment
senses.definition: a medicine or treatment that ends a disease
senses.definitionCN: 结束疾病的药物或疗法
senses.example: There is no cure for the common cold.
senses.exampleCN: 普通感冒没有特效疗法。
senses.why: We name the end of an illness after the thing that ends it.
senses.whyCN: 我们用结束疾病的东西，来称呼疾病的终结。

senses.title: Preserve with salt
senses.definition: to treat food with salt or smoke so that it keeps
senses.definitionCN: 用盐或烟处理食物以便保存
senses.example: They cure the meat in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在冬天腌肉。
senses.why: Salt pulls water out so that nothing spoils.
senses.whyCN: 盐把水抽走，东西就不坏了。

intro.en: Cure comes from Latin cura, care, and curare, to care for a person, through Old French curer.
intro.cn: cure 源自拉丁语 cura（关心、照料）与 curare（照看），经古法语 curer 进入英语。

items.en: Cura meant care and concern.
items.cn: cura 意为关心与挂念。

items.en: Curare meant to take care of a person.
items.cn: curare 意为照看一个人。

items.en: Curer meant to clean or to heal.
items.cn: curer 意为清理或治愈。

items.en: Cure meant to restore a person to health.
items.cn: cure 指使人恢复健康。

items.en: A cure also named the treatment itself.
items.cn: cure 也指治疗手段本身。

items.en: It extended to preserving meat with salt.
items.cn: 它扩展到用盐保存肉类。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cu- opening, and the meaning group names other words for healing and fixing.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cu- 开头，近义组列出其他治愈与解决的说法。

entries.definition: to give medical care to someone
a way of putting something right

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a bitter bowl and end with salt on winter meat.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一碗苦药开始，落到冬天肉上的盐。

normal.en: Cure began as care, not as medicine.
normal.cn: cure 最初是照料，不是药。

normal.en: A doctor cares for a body until it finds its order.
normal.cn: 医生照料身体，直到它找回秩序。

normal.en: The cold has no cure, only time.
normal.cn: 感冒没有药，只有时间。

normal.en: Salt cures meat by taking its water away.
normal.cn: 盐靠夺走水来腌肉。

normal.en: One word covers healing a man and keeping a ham.
normal.cn: 一个词既管治好一个人，也管保住一条火腿。

abstract.en: Picture a spoon of dark medicine on a bedside table.
abstract.cn: 想象床头柜上一勺深色药。

abstract.en: Picture a fever line falling on a chart.
abstract.cn: 想象图上的发烧曲线往下走。

abstract.en: Picture white salt rubbed into red meat.
abstract.cn: 想象白盐揉进红肉里。

examples.en: The new drug may cure the disease.
examples.cn: 这种新药也许能治好这种病。

examples.en: They found no cure for the fever.
examples.cn: 他们没找到治这种高烧的疗法。

examples.en: The fish is cured with salt and smoke.
examples.cn: 这鱼用盐和烟腌制。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cure 记成「照料」：拉丁语 cura 是关心，用心照料到病好，就是治愈。

root: 源自拉丁语 cura（关心、照料），动词 curare 意为照看病人，经古法语 curer 进入英语；本义是照料，后指治愈、疗法，也指用盐保存食物。

sensesIntro.en: From caring for a patient, to ending a disease, to preserving food.
sensesIntro.cn: 从照看病人，到结束疾病，再到保存食物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bitter bowl of medicine beside a sickbed.
core.cn: 核心意象：病床边一碗苦药。

branches.en: Care brings the body back to health.
branches.cn: 照料把身体带回健康。

branches.en: The thing that ends an illness is called a cure.
branches.cn: 结束疾病的东西被称为疗法。

branches.en: Salt does for meat what care does for a patient.
branches.cn: 盐对肉做的事，就像照料对病人做的事。

branches.en: The act of caring and the drug both carry the name.
branches.cn: 照料的行为与药物共用一个名字。

branches.en: Ending sickness and keeping food are both cures.
branches.cn: 结束疾病与保存食物都叫 cure。

intro.en: Cure forms words for healing, for what can and cannot be healed, and for the care of feet.
intro.cn: cure 组成一族词，关于治愈、能否治愈，以及足部护理。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cura, care, is the root behind cure, curable, and incurable.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura（照料）是 cure、curable 与 incurable 背后的根。

items.example: The waters are said to be curative.

items.meaning: the process of healing or preserving

items.exampleCN: 没有哪种植物是万灵药。

definition_en: a strong wish to know or learn, or a strange and interesting thing
core_image: 一个孩子蹲在地上，盯着一只翻身的甲虫看很久
scene: 孩子蹲在地上，盯着一只翻身的甲虫看了很久。Her curiosity made her open every drawer in the house.
sceneCN: 这里 curiosity 指「好奇心」（第 1 个义项：强烈想知道或学习的愿望）；句意是好奇心让她把家里每个抽屉都打开了。

senses.title: Wish to know
senses.definition: a strong wish to know or learn something
senses.definitionCN: 强烈想知道或了解某事的愿望
senses.example: Curiosity led her to ask questions all day.
senses.exampleCN: 好奇心让她整天问问题。
senses.why: A mind that wants an answer will not sit still.
senses.whyCN: 想要答案的心，坐不住。

senses.title: A strange object
senses.definition: an object that is strange and interesting
senses.definitionCN: 奇怪而有趣的东西
senses.example: The shop sells old maps and curiosities.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店卖旧地图和稀奇玩意儿。
senses.why: Things that do not fit the pattern get kept.
senses.whyCN: 不合常规的东西，会被留下来。

senses.title: Interest in others' affairs
senses.definition: an eagerness to know about other people's private lives
senses.definitionCN: 急于知道别人私事的愿望
senses.example: Her curiosity about the neighbours annoyed them.
senses.exampleCN: 她对邻居的好奇让他们不快。
senses.why: Not every question is welcome.
senses.whyCN: 并不是每个问题都受欢迎。

intro.en: Curiosity comes from Latin curiositas, the wish to know, from cura, care.
intro.cn: curiosity 源自拉丁语 curiositas（求知的愿望），其根是 cura（关心）。

items.en: Cura meant care and attention.
items.cn: cura 意为关心与用心。

items.en: Curiosus meant careful, then eager to know.
items.cn: curiosus 意为用心的，后来指急于知道。

items.en: Curiositas named the wish to learn.
items.cn: curiositas 指求知的愿望。

items.en: Curiosite kept the wish to know.
items.cn: curiosite 保留了求知的愿望。

items.en: Curiosity also named a rare object worth keeping.
items.cn: curiosity 也指值得收藏的稀奇物件。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- stem, and the meaning group names other kinds of interest in knowing.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cur- 词干，近义组列出其他想了解的说法。

entries.definition: to make a sick person well
a wish to know more about something
entries.definitionCN: 想更多了解某事的愿望

entries.definition: a feeling of surprise and question
a habit of asking many questions

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a child and a beetle and end with a drawer pulled open.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从孩子与甲虫开始，落到被拉开的抽屉。

normal.en: Curiosity is care that will not let a question go.
normal.cn: 好奇心是不肯放过问题的关心。

normal.en: A child can watch one beetle for an hour.
normal.cn: 一个孩子能盯着一只甲虫看一小时。

normal.en: Every drawer in the house was opened once.
normal.cn: 家里每个抽屉都被打开过一次。

normal.en: The same word keeps old maps in a shop.
normal.cn: 同一个词也收着店里的旧地图。

normal.en: Curiosity about neighbours is often not welcome.
normal.cn: 对邻居的好奇，常常不受欢迎。

abstract.en: Picture a small face very close to the ground.
abstract.cn: 想象一张贴得很近地面的小脸。

abstract.en: Picture a finger lifting a stone to see what lives under it.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指掀起石头，看下面住着什么。

abstract.en: Picture a shelf of odd things with paper labels.
abstract.cn: 想象一架贴着纸标签的稀奇物件。

examples.en: Curiosity made him read the whole letter.
examples.cn: 好奇心让他读完了整封信。

examples.en: She asked, out of pure curiosity, where he had been.
examples.cn: 她纯粹出于好奇，问他去了哪里。

examples.en: The old shop is full of curiosities.
examples.cn: 这家老店满是稀奇玩意儿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curiosity 记成「关心到非弄明白不可」：拉丁语 cura 是关心，往前一步就是好奇。

root: 源自拉丁语 curiositas（求知的愿望），其根是 cura（关心）；本义是用心探究，后指好奇心，也指因稀奇而被收藏的物件。

sensesIntro.en: From a wish to know, to a strange object, to interest in other people's lives.
sensesIntro.cn: 从想知道的愿望，到稀奇物件，再到对别人生活的兴趣。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a child crouching over a beetle, unwilling to leave.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个孩子蹲在甲虫旁，舍不得走。

branches.en: A mind that needs the answer keeps asking.
branches.cn: 非要答案的心，会一直问下去。

branches.en: An odd object is kept because it raises questions.
branches.cn: 稀奇物件被留下，是因为它引出问题。

branches.en: The same pull can turn toward other people.
branches.cn: 同一股拉力，也会转向别人的生活。

branches.en: The wish to know and the odd thing feed each other.
branches.cn: 想知道的愿望与稀奇物件互相喂养。

branches.en: A collector and a gossip both follow curiosity.
branches.cn: 收藏者与爱打听的人，都跟着好奇心走。

intro.en: Curiosity belongs to the Latin cura family, with curious and cure close by.
intro.cn: curiosity 属于拉丁语 cura 一族，curious 与 cure 都在旁边。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cura, care, is the root that turned into curiosity and curious.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura（关心）是变成 curiosity 与 curious 的根。

items.example: The child is curious about ants.
She looked curiously at the box.
items.exampleCN: 她好奇地看着那只箱子。

items.example: He was incurious about the world.

items.meaning: a shop selling odd old things
items.example: They found it in a curiosity shop.
items.exampleCN: 他们在一家旧货店找到它。

items.example: The museum began as a cabinet of curiosities.
items.exampleCN: 这座博物馆最初是一只珍奇柜。

definition_en: eager to know or learn, or strange enough to attract notice
core_image: 一只猫把头探进刚打开的纸箱
scene: 纸箱刚打开，猫立刻把头探了进去。The children were curious about the old machine.
sceneCN: 这里 curious 指「好奇的」（第 1 个义项：急切想知道或了解的）；句意是孩子们对那台旧机器很好奇。

senses.title: Eager to know
senses.definition: wanting very much to know or learn something
senses.definitionCN: 非常想知道或了解某事的
senses.example: She was curious about the locked room.
senses.exampleCN: 她对那间锁着的房间很好奇。
senses.why: A closed door is a question standing up.
senses.whyCN: 一扇关着的门，就是一个立着的问题。

senses.title: Strange
senses.definition: unusual in a way that makes people notice
senses.definitionCN: 不寻常到引人注意的
senses.example: A curious smell came from the box.
senses.exampleCN: 箱子里传出一股奇怪的气味。
senses.why: What does not fit our pattern asks to be explained.
senses.whyCN: 不合我们套路的东西，会要求一个解释。

senses.title: Carefully made
senses.definition: made with care and skill, in older use
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法中指用心做成的
senses.example: The old clock is a curious piece of work.
senses.exampleCN: 这座旧钟是一件精细的作品。
senses.why: Care in making leaves a visible trace.
senses.whyCN: 制作时的用心会留下看得见的痕迹。

intro.en: Curious comes from Latin curiosus, careful and eager to know, from cura, care.
intro.cn: curious 源自拉丁语 curiosus（用心的、爱探究的），其根是 cura（关心）。

items.en: Cura meant care and attention.
items.cn: cura 意为关心与用心。

items.en: Curiosus meant full of care.
items.cn: curiosus 意为充满用心。

items.en: It then meant eager to know.
items.cn: 它后来指急于知道。

items.en: Curius kept the eager sense.
items.cn: curius 保留了急切这层意思。

items.en: Curious meant careful and skillful.
items.cn: curious 意为细心而有技艺的。

items.en: It settled into eager to know, and strange.
items.cn: 它固定为好奇的，也有奇怪的。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- stem, and the meaning group names other words for wanting to know and for oddness.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cur- 词干，近义组列出其他表示想了解与古怪的说法。

entries.definition: to make a sick person well

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a cat and a box and end with an old clock made by hand.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从猫与纸箱开始，落到一只手工做的旧钟。

normal.en: A curious mind treats every box as a door.
normal.cn: 好奇的心，把每个箱子都当成门。

normal.en: Cats are the picture of curious.
normal.cn: 猫就是好奇的样子。

normal.en: The same word means strange, because strangeness asks questions.
normal.cn: 同一个词也表示奇怪，因为古怪会引出问题。

normal.en: An old clock can be curious work, made with care.
normal.cn: 一只旧钟可以是一件精细的作品。

normal.en: Curious people learn faster and sleep less.
normal.cn: 好奇的人学得快，也睡得少。

abstract.en: Picture a cat with its head deep in a box.
abstract.cn: 想象一只猫把头埋进箱子里。

abstract.en: Picture a smell that makes you turn your head.
abstract.cn: 想象一股气味让你转过头。

abstract.en: Picture small gears fitted by a careful hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一只谨慎的手装好的小齿轮。

examples.en: The child was curious about the stars.
examples.cn: 这孩子对星星很好奇。

examples.en: I am curious to know how it ends.
examples.cn: 我很想知道结局。

examples.en: There was a curious mark on the wall.
examples.cn: 墙上有一个奇怪的痕迹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curious 记成「心里放不下」：cur 是关心，心里一直挂着，就变成了好奇。

root: 源自拉丁语 curiosus（用心的、爱探究的），其根是 cura（关心）；本义是用心，后指渴望知道，也指因少见而显得奇怪。

sensesIntro.en: From eager to know, to strange, to carefully made.
sensesIntro.cn: 从渴望知道，到奇怪，再到用心做成。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cat pushing its head into a newly opened box.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只猫把头探进刚打开的纸箱。

branches.en: Something unknown pulls the mind toward it.
branches.cn: 未知的东西把心拉过去。

branches.en: A thing that does not fit is called curious too.
branches.cn: 不合套的东西，也叫奇怪的。

branches.en: Older speech used it for careful, fine work.
branches.cn: 较早的说法用它形容精细的活。

branches.en: The wish to know and the odd thing explain each other.
branches.cn: 想知道的愿望与古怪的东西彼此解释。

branches.en: Careful work and strange work both draw the eye.
branches.cn: 精细的活与古怪的活都招人看。

intro.en: Curious is the adjective that supports curiosity, curiously, and their compounds.
intro.cn: curious 是支撑 curiosity、curiously 及其合成词的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cura, care, is the root under curious and its whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura（关心）是 curious 及其整族词背后的根。

items.exampleCN: 毫无好奇心的头脑会错过很多。

items.example: The shelf held a small curio.

items.meaning: a shop selling odd old things
items.example: They met in a curiosity shop.
items.exampleCN: 他们在一家旧货店相遇。

items.example: Care can cure what drugs cannot.
items.exampleCN: 照料能治好药治不好的东西。

definition_en: in a way that shows a wish to know, or in a strange way
core_image: 一个人歪着头，慢慢凑近看一样东西
scene: 他歪着头，慢慢把脸凑近那枚旧硬币。She looked curiously at the small door in the wall.
sceneCN: 这里 curiously 指「好奇地」（第 1 个义项：带着想知道的兴趣）；句意是她好奇地看着墙上的那扇小门。

senses.title: In a curious way
senses.definition: with a strong wish to know or see more
senses.definitionCN: 带着强烈想知道或看更多的愿望
senses.example: He looked curiously at the old map.
senses.exampleCN: 他好奇地看着那张旧地图。
senses.why: The body leans in when the mind wants more.
senses.whyCN: 心里想要更多时，身体会往前倾。

senses.title: Strangely
senses.definition: in a way that seems strange or hard to explain
senses.definitionCN: 以显得奇怪或难以解释的方式
senses.example: The room was curiously quiet.
senses.exampleCN: 房间里安静得奇怪。
senses.why: A thing can be odd in how it behaves, not just in how it looks.
senses.whyCN: 事物的古怪，可能在它的举止，而不只在样子。

senses.title: With care, in older use
senses.definition: with care and skill, in older writing
senses.definitionCN: 旧文字中指用心而有技艺地
senses.example: The box was curiously carved.
senses.exampleCN: 这只箱子雕刻得十分精细。
senses.why: Care shows in small repeated cuts.
senses.whyCN: 用心显在一刀刀细小的刻痕里。

intro.en: Curiously is curious plus -ly; curious comes from Latin curiosus, from cura, care.
intro.cn: curiously 由 curious 加 -ly 构成；curious 源自拉丁语 curiosus，其根是 cura（关心）。

items.en: Cura meant care and attention.
items.cn: cura 意为关心与用心。

items.en: Curiosus meant careful and eager to know.
items.cn: curiosus 意为用心的、急于知道的。

items.en: Curious meant careful and skillful.
items.cn: curious 意为细心而有技艺的。

items.en: Curious settled into eager to know and strange.
items.cn: curious 固定为好奇的与奇怪的。

items.en: The adverb curiously followed the adjective.
items.cn: 副词 curiously 随后出现。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the curi- stem, and the meaning group names other adverbs of manner and oddness.
note.cn: 形近组共享 curi- 词干，近义组列出其他表示方式与古怪的副词。

entries.definition: in a way that seems odd

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a tilted head and end with a strangely quiet room.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从歪着的头开始，落到一间安静得奇怪的房间。

normal.en: Curiously is how the body moves when the mind asks.
normal.cn: curiously 就是心里发问时身体的动法。

normal.en: A head tilts before a question is spoken.
normal.cn: 问题出口前，头先歪过去。

normal.en: An old map can hold a person for an hour.
normal.cn: 一张旧地图能留住一个人一小时。

normal.en: The same word says a room is oddly quiet.
normal.cn: 同一个词也说房间安静得奇怪。

normal.en: Add -ly and the looking becomes a manner.
normal.cn: 加上 -ly，看就变成了一种方式。

abstract.en: Picture an eye moving closer to a small coin.
abstract.cn: 想象一只眼睛凑近一枚小硬币。

abstract.en: Picture fingers turning a page very slowly.
abstract.cn: 想象手指很慢地翻过一页。

abstract.en: Picture a clock that ticks too softly.
abstract.cn: 想象一只走得过于轻的钟。

examples.en: She looked curiously at the stranger.
examples.cn: 她好奇地看着那个陌生人。

examples.en: The street was curiously empty at noon.
examples.cn: 中午的街道空得奇怪。

examples.en: He asked curiously how the trick worked.
examples.cn: 他好奇地问这戏法是怎么回事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curiously 记成「带着问号地」：curious 是好奇，加上 -ly，就成了好奇地或奇怪地。

root: 由 curious 加副词后缀 -ly 构成；curious 源自拉丁语 curiosus（用心的、爱探究的），其根是 cura（关心），因此 curiously 兼有「好奇地」与「奇怪地」两义。

sensesIntro.en: From a look that wants more, to a manner that seems odd, to older work done with care.
sensesIntro.cn: 从想要更多的目光，到显得古怪的举止，再到旧时精细的手艺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a head tilted, an eye moving closer to an object.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个歪着的头，一只越凑越近的眼睛。

branches.en: The manner shows a mind that wants more.
branches.cn: 这种方式显出想要更多的心。

branches.en: The same manner can make a thing seem odd.
branches.cn: 同一种方式，也能让事物显得古怪。

branches.en: Older writing used it for work done with care.
branches.cn: 较早的文字用它形容用心做出的活。

branches.en: Wanting to know and finding things odd sit close together.
branches.cn: 想了解与觉得古怪挨得很近。

branches.en: A carefully made thing can look strange to untrained eyes.
branches.cn: 精细之物在外行眼里可能显得奇怪。

intro.en: Curiously is the adverb built on curious, inside the large Latin cura family.
intro.cn: curiously 是由 curious 构成的副词，属于庞大的拉丁语 cura 一族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cura, care, travels through curiosus into curious and curiously.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura（关心）经 curiosus 进入 curious 与 curiously。

items.example: He glanced incuriously at the page.
items.exampleCN: 他毫无好奇地瞥了一眼那页。

items.example: A curio stood on the desk.

definition_en: to twist into a curved shape, or a curved piece of hair
core_image: 一缕头发在手指上绕了一圈
scene: 她用手指把一缕头发绕了一圈，松手后就成了卷。She likes to curl her hair before going out.
sceneCN: 这里 curl 指「卷曲」（第 1 个义项：把某物绕成弯曲的形状）；句意是她出门前喜欢把头发卷起来。

senses.title: Twist into curves
senses.definition: to twist something into a curved or spiral shape
senses.definitionCN: 把某物绕成弯曲或螺旋的形状
senses.example: She curled the ribbon with a knife.
senses.exampleCN: 她用刀把丝带卷弯。
senses.why: A straight line can be taught to bend.
senses.whyCN: 直线也能被教着弯起来。

senses.title: A lock of curved hair
senses.definition: a piece of hair that grows or is shaped in a curve
senses.definitionCN: 长成或做成弯曲的一缕头发
senses.example: A dark curl fell over her eye.
senses.exampleCN: 一缕深色卷发垂到她眼前。
senses.why: Hair remembers the shape it was given.
senses.whyCN: 头发会记住被赋予的形状。

senses.title: Lie in a round shape
senses.definition: to lie with the body pulled into a round shape
senses.definitionCN: 把身体收成圆形躺着
senses.example: The cat curled up by the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 猫在火边蜷成一团。
senses.why: Warmth is kept best in a small circle.
senses.whyCN: 暖意最容易被收在一个小圈里。

intro.en: Curl comes from Middle English curlen, probably from Dutch krullen, to curl hair.
intro.cn: curl 源自中古英语 curlen，可能出自荷兰语 krullen（卷发）。

items.en: Curlen meant to bend into a curve.
items.cn: curlen 意为弯成弧形。

items.en: Krullen meant to curl the hair.
items.cn: krullen 意为把头发卷起来。

items.en: Curl named a curved lock of hair.
items.cn: curl 指弯曲的一缕头发。

items.en: It spread to smoke, waves, and paper.
items.cn: 它扩展到烟、波浪与纸张。

items.en: To curl up meant to draw the body into a ball.
items.cn: curl up 指把身体收成一团。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cur- opening and a liquid end, and the meaning group names other twisting shapes.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cur- 开头与流音结尾，近义组列出其他绕曲形状的说法。

entries.definition: to make a sick person well
the raised edge of a road
to wind into a series of rings
a curve in hair or water

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a finger and a lock of hair and end with a cat by the fire.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从手指与一缕头发开始，落到火边的猫。

normal.en: A curl is a line that changed its mind and turned back.
normal.cn: 卷曲是一条改了主意、又折回来的线。

normal.en: Wind hair once and it holds the shape.
normal.cn: 头发绕一圈，就记住了形状。

normal.en: Smoke curls because it cannot go straight up.
normal.cn: 烟会打卷，是因为它没法笔直上升。

normal.en: A cat curls up to keep its warmth.
normal.cn: 猫蜷起来是为了保住暖意。

normal.en: The same word serves hair, smoke, and a sleeping animal.
normal.cn: 同一个词管头发、烟和睡着的动物。

abstract.en: Picture a lock of hair around one finger.
abstract.cn: 想象一缕头发绕在一根手指上。

abstract.en: Picture a thin line of smoke bending near the ceiling.
abstract.cn: 想象一缕细烟在天花板附近弯折。

abstract.en: Picture a cat making itself into a small circle.
abstract.cn: 想象一只猫把自己收成一个小圆。

examples.en: She curled her hair for the party.
examples.cn: 她为聚会把头发卷了。

examples.en: A curl of smoke rose from the candle.
examples.cn: 一缕烟从蜡烛上升起。

examples.en: The dog curled up on the warm floor.
examples.cn: 狗在温暖的地板上蜷成一团。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 curl 记成「绕一圈」：手指绕头发，一缕烟往上绕，猫把身子绕成球。

root: 中古英语 curlen，可能出自荷兰语 krullen（卷发）或北欧语；本义是弯成弧形，后指卷发、卷曲之物与蜷缩。

sensesIntro.en: From twisting a shape, to a curved lock, to a body drawn into a ball.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把形状绕弯，到一缕卷发，再到收成一团的身体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lock of hair wound once around a finger.
core.cn: 核心意象：一缕头发在手指上绕了一圈。

branches.en: A hand can teach a straight thing to bend.
branches.cn: 手能教直的东西弯起来。

branches.en: Hair keeps a curve once it is given one.
branches.cn: 头发被做出弯度，就留住了弯度。

branches.en: A body curls to keep warm and safe.
branches.cn: 身体蜷起来，是为了暖和与安全。

branches.en: The act of twisting and the twisted lock share one name.
branches.cn: 绕的动作与绕成的一缕共用一个名字。

branches.en: A curl of hair and a curled cat are both round shapes.
branches.cn: 卷发与蜷缩的猫，都是圆的形状。

intro.en: Curl forms words for hair, for tools that shape it, and for the act of bending round.
intro.cn: curl 组成一族词，关于头发、卷发工具与绕弯的动作。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root here; curl comes from Middle English curlen, perhaps Dutch krullen.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根；curl 来自中古英语 curlen，可能出自荷兰语 krullen。

items.meaning: a sport played with sliding stones

items.example: The leaf lay curled on the path.

items.meaning: to draw the body into a ball
items.example: The child curled up under a blanket.

items.meaning: a thin twisting line of smoke
items.example: A curl of smoke left the chimney.
